9. 项目场景面试题

9.1 高并发场景

如何设计一个秒杀系统？ ▶

秒杀系统设计要点

1. 前端优化：

  • 页面静态化，减少服务器压力
  • CDN加速，就近访问
  • 按钮置灰，防止重复提交
  • 验证码机制，防止机器刷单

2. 后端架构：

// 秒杀接口设计
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/seckill")
public class SeckillController {
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate redisTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;
    
    @PostMapping("/buy")
    public Result seckill(@RequestParam Long productId, 
                         @RequestParam Long userId) {
        
        // 1. 参数校验
        if (productId == null || userId == null) {
            return Result.error("参数错误");
        }
        
        // 2. Redis预减库存
        String stockKey = "seckill:stock:" + productId;
        Long stock = redisTemplate.opsForValue().decrement(stockKey);
        
        if (stock < 0) {
            // 库存不足，恢复库存
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().increment(stockKey);
            return Result.error("商品已售完");
        }
        
        // 3. 异步处理订单
        SeckillMessage message = new SeckillMessage(productId, userId);
        rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend("seckill.queue", message);
        
        return Result.success("排队中，请稍后查询结果");
    }
}

3. 关键技术点：

  • Redis预减库存：避免数据库压力
  • 消息队列异步处理：削峰填谷
  • 分布式锁：防止超卖
  • 限流降级：保护系统稳定性
如何处理高并发下的缓存穿透、击穿、雪崩？ ▶

缓存问题解决方案

1. 缓存穿透（查询不存在的数据）：

// 布隆过滤器解决方案
@Service
public class UserService {
    
    @Autowired
    private BloomFilter<String> bloomFilter;
    
    public User getUserById(String userId) {
        // 先检查布隆过滤器
        if (!bloomFilter.mightContain(userId)) {
            return null; // 一定不存在
        }
        
        // 查询缓存
        User user = redisTemplate.opsForValue().get("user:" + userId);
        if (user != null) {
            return user;
        }
        
        // 查询数据库
        user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
        if (user != null) {
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("user:" + userId, user, 30, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
        } else {
            // 缓存空值，防止穿透
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("user:" + userId, "NULL", 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
        }
        
        return user;
    }
}

2. 缓存击穿（热点数据过期）：

// 分布式锁解决方案
public User getUserByIdWithLock(String userId) {
    String lockKey = "lock:user:" + userId;
    String lockValue = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    
    try {
        // 尝试获取分布式锁
        Boolean locked = redisTemplate.opsForValue()
            .setIfAbsent(lockKey, lockValue, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        
        if (locked) {
            // 获取锁成功，查询数据库并更新缓存
            User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (user != null) {
                redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("user:" + userId, user, 30, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
            }
            return user;
        } else {
            // 获取锁失败，等待后重试
            Thread.sleep(100);
            return getUserById(userId);
        }
    } finally {
        // 释放锁
        releaseLock(lockKey, lockValue);
    }
}

3. 缓存雪崩（大量缓存同时失效）：

  • 设置随机过期时间
  • 使用多级缓存
  • 限流降级
  • 缓存预热

9.2 分布式系统

如何实现分布式事务？ ▶

分布式事务解决方案

1. 两阶段提交（2PC）：

  • 准备阶段：协调者询问所有参与者是否可以提交
  • 提交阶段：根据参与者响应决定提交或回滚
  • 缺点：性能差，存在单点故障

2. TCC（Try-Confirm-Cancel）：

// TCC模式示例
@Service
public class AccountService {
    
    // Try阶段：预留资源
    public boolean tryDeduct(String accountId, BigDecimal amount) {
        // 冻结账户金额
        return accountMapper.freezeAmount(accountId, amount) > 0;
    }
    
    // Confirm阶段：确认提交
    public boolean confirmDeduct(String accountId, BigDecimal amount) {
        // 扣减冻结金额
        return accountMapper.deductFrozenAmount(accountId, amount) > 0;
    }
    
    // Cancel阶段：取消操作
    public boolean cancelDeduct(String accountId, BigDecimal amount) {
        // 解冻账户金额
        return accountMapper.unfreezeAmount(accountId, amount) > 0;
    }
}

3. Saga模式：

  • 将长事务拆分为多个本地事务
  • 每个本地事务都有对应的补偿操作
  • 适用于长流程业务

4. 最终一致性（基于消息）：

// 基于消息的最终一致性
@Transactional
public void createOrder(Order order) {
    // 1. 创建订单
    orderMapper.insert(order);
    
    // 2. 发送消息（事务消息）
    OrderCreatedEvent event = new OrderCreatedEvent(order.getId());
    messageProducer.sendTransactionalMessage(event);
}

// 消息消费者
@RabbitListener(queues = "order.created")
public void handleOrderCreated(OrderCreatedEvent event) {
    // 扣减库存
    inventoryService.deductStock(event.getOrderId());
    
    // 扣减积分
    pointService.deductPoints(event.getUserId(), event.getPoints());
}
如何实现分布式锁？ ▶

分布式锁实现方案

1. 基于Redis的分布式锁：

@Component
public class RedisDistributedLock {
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, String> redisTemplate;
    
    private static final String UNLOCK_SCRIPT = 
        "if redis.call('get', KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then " +
        "return redis.call('del', KEYS[1]) " +
        "else return 0 end";
    
    public boolean tryLock(String key, String value, long expireTime) {
        Boolean result = redisTemplate.opsForValue()
            .setIfAbsent(key, value, expireTime, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        return result != null && result;
    }
    
    public boolean unlock(String key, String value) {
        DefaultRedisScript<Long> script = new DefaultRedisScript<>();
        script.setScriptText(UNLOCK_SCRIPT);
        script.setResultType(Long.class);
        
        Long result = redisTemplate.execute(script, 
            Collections.singletonList(key), value);
        return result != null && result == 1L;
    }
}

2. 基于Zookeeper的分布式锁：

  • 利用临时顺序节点实现
  • 具有阻塞特性
  • 可重入锁支持

3. 基于数据库的分布式锁：

  • 利用唯一索引实现
  • 性能相对较差
  • 适用于对性能要求不高的场景

9.4 数据一致性

如何保证缓存与数据库的数据一致性？ ▶

缓存一致性解决方案

1. Cache Aside模式（旁路缓存）：

@Service
public class UserService {
    
    // 读操作
    public User getUser(Long id) {
        // 1. 先查缓存
        User user = redisTemplate.opsForValue().get("user:" + id);
        if (user != null) {
            return user;
        }
        
        // 2. 缓存未命中，查数据库
        user = userMapper.selectById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            // 3. 写入缓存
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("user:" + id, user, 30, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    // 写操作
    @Transactional
    public void updateUser(User user) {
        // 1. 先更新数据库
        userMapper.updateById(user);
        
        // 2. 删除缓存
        redisTemplate.delete("user:" + user.getId());
    }
}

2. Write Through模式（写穿透）：

  • 写操作同时更新缓存和数据库
  • 保证强一致性
  • 性能相对较差

3. Write Behind模式（写回）：

  • 只更新缓存，异步更新数据库
  • 性能最好
  • 可能存在数据丢失风险

4. 基于Canal的数据同步：

// Canal监听MySQL binlog
@Component
public class CanalDataSyncHandler {
    
    @EventListener
    public void handleDataChange(CanalEntry.Entry entry) {
        if (entry.getEntryType() == CanalEntry.EntryType.ROWDATA) {
            CanalEntry.RowChange rowChange = CanalEntry.RowChange.parseFrom(entry.getStoreValue());
            
            for (CanalEntry.RowData rowData : rowChange.getRowDatasList()) {
                if (rowChange.getEventType() == CanalEntry.EventType.UPDATE) {
                    // 更新缓存
                    updateCache(rowData);
                } else if (rowChange.getEventType() == CanalEntry.EventType.DELETE) {
                    // 删除缓存
                    deleteCache(rowData);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

如何设计一个短链接系统？ ▶

短链接系统设计

1. 系统架构：

  • 接入层：Nginx负载均衡
  • 应用层：Spring Boot微服务
  • 缓存层：Redis集群
  • 存储层：MySQL分库分表

2. 短链生成算法：

@Service
public class ShortUrlService {
    
    private static final String BASE62 = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
    
    // 基于自增ID的Base62编码
    public String generateShortUrl(String longUrl) {
        // 1. 获取自增ID
        Long id = idGenerator.nextId();
        
        // 2. Base62编码
        String shortCode = base62Encode(id);
        
        // 3. 存储映射关系
        UrlMapping mapping = new UrlMapping();
        mapping.setShortCode(shortCode);
        mapping.setLongUrl(longUrl);
        mapping.setCreateTime(new Date());
        
        urlMappingMapper.insert(mapping);
        
        // 4. 缓存热点数据
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(shortCode, longUrl, 24, TimeUnit.HOURS);
        
        return "https://short.ly/" + shortCode;
    }
    
    private String base62Encode(long num) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (num > 0) {
            sb.append(BASE62.charAt((int) (num % 62)));
            num /= 62;
        }
        return sb.reverse().toString();
    }
    
    // 短链还原
    public String getLongUrl(String shortCode) {
        // 1. 先查缓存
        String longUrl = redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(shortCode);
        if (longUrl != null) {
            return longUrl;
        }
        
        // 2. 查数据库
        UrlMapping mapping = urlMappingMapper.selectByShortCode(shortCode);
        if (mapping != null) {
            // 3. 回写缓存
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(shortCode, mapping.getLongUrl(), 24, TimeUnit.HOURS);
            return mapping.getLongUrl();
        }
        
        return null;
    }
}

3. 性能优化：

  • 布隆过滤器：快速判断短链是否存在
  • LRU缓存：缓存热点短链
  • CDN加速：就近访问
  • 异步统计：点击量统计
如何设计一个消息推送系统？ ▶

消息推送系统设计

1. 系统架构：

  • 推送网关：统一推送入口

2. 核心实现：

@Service
public class MessagePushService {
    
    @Autowired
    private List<PushChannel> pushChannels;
    
    public void pushMessage(PushRequest request) {
        // 1. 参数校验
        validateRequest(request);
        
        // 2. 用户偏好路由
        List<PushChannel> channels = routeChannels(request.getUserId());
        
        // 3. 异步推送
        for (PushChannel channel : channels) {
            CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
                try {
                    PushResult result = channel.push(request);
                    // 记录推送结果
                    recordPushResult(request.getMessageId(), channel.getType(), result);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    // 推送失败，记录日志
                    logger.error("Push failed: {}", e.getMessage());
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    private List<PushChannel> routeChannels(String userId) {
        // 根据用户偏好选择推送渠道
        UserPreference preference = userPreferenceService.getByUserId(userId);
        
        return pushChannels.stream()
            .filter(channel -> preference.isEnabled(channel.getType()))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

3. 推送渠道实现：

// 短信推送渠道
@Component
public class SmsChannel implements PushChannel {
    
    @Override

        // 调用短信服务商API

            request.getPhone(),

// 邮件推送渠道
@Component
public class EmailChannel implements PushChannel {
    
    @Override

        // 发送邮件

        message.setTo(request.getEmail());

        return ChannelType.EMAIL;
    }
}

9.6 性能指标与监控

如何设计和优化系统QPS？ ▶

QPS优化策略

1. QPS计算与监控：

// QPS监控组件
@Component
public class QpsMonitor {
    
    private final AtomicLong requestCount = new AtomicLong(0);
    private final AtomicLong lastResetTime = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis());
    
    // 记录请求
    public void recordRequest() {
        requestCount.incrementAndGet();
    }
    
    // 获取当前QPS
    public double getCurrentQps() {
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long lastReset = lastResetTime.get();
        long timeElapsed = currentTime - lastReset;
        
        if (timeElapsed >= 1000) { // 每秒重置一次
            long count = requestCount.getAndSet(0);
            lastResetTime.set(currentTime);
            return count * 1000.0 / timeElapsed;
        }
        
        return requestCount.get() * 1000.0 / timeElapsed;
    }
}

// QPS拦截器
@Component
public class QpsInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
    
    @Autowired
    private QpsMonitor qpsMonitor;
    
    @Override
    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, 
                              HttpServletResponse response, 
                              Object handler) {
        qpsMonitor.recordRequest();
        
        // QPS限流
        double currentQps = qpsMonitor.getCurrentQps();
        if (currentQps > 1000) { // 限制QPS为1000
            response.setStatus(429); // Too Many Requests
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
}

2. QPS优化技术：

  • 水平扩展：增加服务器实例
  • 负载均衡：合理分配请求
  • 缓存优化：减少数据库访问
  • 异步处理：提高并发能力
  • 连接池优化：复用数据库连接

3. 压力测试：

// JMeter压力测试脚本示例
// 测试配置：

如何统计和分析DAU（日活跃用户）？ ▶

DAU统计系统设计

1. DAU数据收集：

// 用户活跃度记录
@Service
public class UserActivityService {
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, String> redisTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private UserActivityMapper userActivityMapper;
    
    // 记录用户活跃
    public void recordUserActivity(String userId) {
        String today = LocalDate.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE);
        String key = "dau:" + today;
        
        // 使用Redis BitMap记录用户活跃
        long userIdLong = Long.parseLong(userId);
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().setBit(key, userIdLong, true);
        
        // 设置过期时间（保留30天）
        redisTemplate.expire(key, 30, TimeUnit.DAYS);
        
        // 异步记录详细活跃信息
        CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
            UserActivity activity = new UserActivity();
            activity.setUserId(userId);
            activity.setActivityDate(LocalDate.now());
            activity.setLastActiveTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            
            userActivityMapper.insertOrUpdate(activity);
        });
    }
    
    // 获取DAU
    public long getDailyActiveUsers(LocalDate date) {
        String dateStr = date.format(DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE);
        String key = "dau:" + dateStr;
        
        // 使用Redis BITCOUNT统计活跃用户数
        return redisTemplate.execute((RedisCallback<Long>) connection -> {
            return connection.bitCount(key.getBytes());
        });
    }
    
    // 获取周活跃用户（WAU）
    public long getWeeklyActiveUsers(LocalDate endDate) {
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            String dateStr = endDate.minusDays(i)
                .format(DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE);
            keys.add("dau:" + dateStr);
        }
        
        // 使用Redis BITOP OR操作合并多天数据
        String tempKey = "wau:temp:" + System.currentTimeMillis();
        redisTemplate.execute((RedisCallback<Void>) connection -> {
            connection.bitOp(RedisStringCommands.BitOperation.OR, 
                tempKey.getBytes(), 
                keys.stream().map(String::getBytes).toArray(byte[][]::new));
            return null;
        });
        
        long wau = redisTemplate.execute((RedisCallback<Long>) connection -> {
            return connection.bitCount(tempKey.getBytes());
        });
        
        // 删除临时key
        redisTemplate.delete(tempKey);
        
        return wau;
    }
}

2. DAU数据分析：

// DAU分析服务
@Service
public class DauAnalysisService {
    
    // 计算用户留存率
    public Map<String, Double> calculateRetentionRate(LocalDate startDate) {
        Map<String, Double> retentionRates = new HashMap<>();
        
        // 获取起始日期的活跃用户
        Set<String> baseUsers = getActiveUsers(startDate);
        long baseCount = baseUsers.size();
        
        // 计算1日、3日、7日、30日留存
        int[] retentionDays = {1, 3, 7, 30};
        
        for (int day : retentionDays) {
            Set<String> retentionUsers = getActiveUsers(startDate.plusDays(day));
            retentionUsers.retainAll(baseUsers); // 求交集
            
            double retentionRate = baseCount > 0 ? 
                (double) retentionUsers.size() / baseCount * 100 : 0;
            
            retentionRates.put(day + "日留存", retentionRate);
        }
        
        return retentionRates;
    }
    
    // 获取DAU趋势
    public List<DauTrend> getDauTrend(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {
        List<DauTrend> trends = new ArrayList<>();
        
        LocalDate current = startDate;
        while (!current.isAfter(endDate)) {
            long dau = userActivityService.getDailyActiveUsers(current);
            
            DauTrend trend = new DauTrend();
            trend.setDate(current);
            trend.setDau(dau);
            
            // 计算环比增长率
            if (!trends.isEmpty()) {
                DauTrend previous = trends.get(trends.size() - 1);
                double growthRate = previous.getDau() > 0 ? 
                    (double) (dau - previous.getDau()) / previous.getDau() * 100 : 0;
                trend.setGrowthRate(growthRate);
            }
            
            trends.add(trend);
            current = current.plusDays(1);
        }
        
        return trends;
    }
}

3. DAU监控告警：

// DAU监控任务
@Component
public class DauMonitorTask {
    
    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 1 * * ?") // 每天凌晨1点执行
    public void monitorDau() {
        LocalDate yesterday = LocalDate.now().minusDays(1);
        long yesterdayDau = userActivityService.getDailyActiveUsers(yesterday);
        
        // 获取前一天的DAU作为基准
        LocalDate dayBeforeYesterday = yesterday.minusDays(1);
        long baselineDau = userActivityService.getDailyActiveUsers(dayBeforeYesterday);
        
        // 计算下降幅度
        if (baselineDau > 0) {
            double decreaseRate = (double) (baselineDau - yesterdayDau) / baselineDau * 100;
            
            // DAU下降超过20%时告警
            if (decreaseRate > 20) {
                sendDauAlert(yesterday, yesterdayDau, baselineDau, decreaseRate);
            }
        }
        
        // 记录DAU统计结果
        saveDauStatistics(yesterday, yesterdayDau);
    }
    
    private void sendDauAlert(LocalDate date, long currentDau, 
                            long baselineDau, double decreaseRate) {
        String message = String.format(
            "DAU告警：%s DAU为%d，较前一天下降%.2f%%（前一天：%d）",
            date, currentDau, decreaseRate, baselineDau
        );
        
        // 发送告警消息（邮件、短信、钉钉等）
        alertService.sendAlert("DAU异常告警", message);
    }
}

// 流量监控组件
@Component
public class TrafficMonitor {
    
    private final SlidingWindowCounter counter = new SlidingWindowCounter(60); // 60秒窗口
    
    @EventListener
    public void onRequest(RequestEvent event) {
        counter.increment();
        
        // 检查是否超过阈值
        long currentQps = counter.getCount() / 60;
        if (currentQps > 5000) { // QPS超过5000时预警
            triggerTrafficAlert(currentQps);
        }
    }
    
    private void triggerTrafficAlert(long qps) {
        // 触发自动扩容
        autoScalingService.scaleOut();
        
        // 启用限流
        rateLimiterService.enableEmergencyLimiting();
        
        // 发送告警
        alertService.sendAlert("高流量告警", "当前QPS: " + qps);
    }
}

// 自动扩容服务
@Service
public class AutoScalingService {
    
    public void scaleOut() {
        // 1. 检查当前实例数
        int currentInstances = getCurrentInstanceCount();
        int maxInstances = 20; // 最大实例数限制
        
        if (currentInstances < maxInstances) {
            // 2. 启动新实例
            int newInstances = Math.min(3, maxInstances - currentInstances);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < newInstances; i++) {
                startNewInstance();
            }
            
            // 3. 更新负载均衡配置
            loadBalancerService.updateUpstreamServers();
            
            logger.info("Auto scaling: started {} new instances", newInstances);
        }
    }
    
    private void startNewInstance() {
        // 调用云服务API启动新实例
        // 或者通过Kubernetes扩容Pod
        kubernetesClient.scaleDeployment("app-deployment", 1);
    }
}

10万并发系统设计方案

2. 服务器配置计算：

// 服务器配置计算工具
@Component
public class ServerConfigCalculator {
    
    /**
     * 计算所需服务器配置
     * @param concurrentUsers 并发用户数
     * @param avgResponseTime 平均响应时间(ms)
     * @param memoryPerRequest 每个请求占用内存(KB)
     * @return 服务器配置建议
     */
    public ServerConfig calculateConfig(int concurrentUsers, 
                                        int avgResponseTime, 
                                        int memoryPerRequest) {
        
        // 1. 计算QPS
        int qps = concurrentUsers * 1000 / avgResponseTime;
        
        // 2. 计算所需线程数（考虑20%缓冲）
        int threadsPerServer = (int) (concurrentUsers * 1.2 / 10); // 假设10台服务器
        
        // 3. 计算内存需求
        long memoryPerServer = (long) threadsPerServer * memoryPerRequest * 1024; // 转换为字节
        long heapMemory = memoryPerServer * 2; // 堆内存是工作内存的2倍
        long totalMemory = heapMemory + 2L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 加上2GB系统内存
        
        // 4. 计算CPU核数
        int cpuCores = Math.max(8, threadsPerServer / 4); // 每4个线程需要1个CPU核
        
        return new ServerConfig(cpuCores, totalMemory, threadsPerServer, qps);
    }
}

// 服务器配置实体
@Data
public class ServerConfig {
    private int cpuCores;           // CPU核数
    private long memoryBytes;       // 内存大小(字节)
    private int maxThreads;        // 最大线程数
    private int expectedQps;       // 预期QPS
    
    public String getMemoryGB() {
        return String.format("%.1fGB", memoryBytes / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
    }
}

4. 内存优化策略：

// 内存监控和优化组件
@Component
public class MemoryOptimizer {
    
    private final MemoryMXBean memoryBean = ManagementFactory.getMemoryMXBean();
    
    // 内存使用率监控
    @Scheduled(fixedRate = 30000) // 每30秒检查一次
    public void monitorMemory() {
        MemoryUsage heapUsage = memoryBean.getHeapMemoryUsage();
        long used = heapUsage.getUsed();
        long max = heapUsage.getMax();
        
        double usagePercent = (double) used / max * 100;
        
        if (usagePercent > 80) {
            logger.warn("内存使用率过高: {}%", usagePercent);
            
            // 触发内存清理
            triggerMemoryCleanup();
            
            // 启用限流保护
            rateLimiterService.enableEmergencyMode();
        }
    }
    
    private void triggerMemoryCleanup() {
        // 1. 清理缓存
        cacheManager.evictExpiredEntries();
        
        // 2. 建议GC
        System.gc();
        
        // 3. 清理线程本地变量
        cleanupThreadLocals();
    }
    
    private void cleanupThreadLocals() {
        // 清理可能导致内存泄漏的ThreadLocal变量
        ThreadLocalCleaner.cleanup();
    }
}

// 限流配置
@Configuration
public class RateLimitConfig {
    
    @Bean
    public RateLimiter globalRateLimiter() {
        // 全局限流：每秒最多处理8000个请求
        return RateLimiter.create(8000.0);
    }
    
    @Bean
    public CircuitBreaker circuitBreaker() {
        return CircuitBreaker.ofDefaults("globalCircuitBreaker");
    }
}

// 请求拦截器
@Component
public class RequestLimitInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
    
    @Autowired
    private RateLimiter rateLimiter;
    
    @Override
    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, 
                              HttpServletResponse response, 
                              Object handler) {
        
        // 限流检查
        if (!rateLimiter.tryAcquire(100, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) {
            response.setStatus(429); // Too Many Requests
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
}

// 系统监控指标
@RestController
public class SystemMetricsController {
    
    @GetMapping("/metrics/system")
    public Map<String, Object> getSystemMetrics() {
        Map<String, Object> metrics = new HashMap<>();
        
        // 内存使用情况
        MemoryUsage heapUsage = ManagementFactory.getMemoryMXBean().getHeapMemoryUsage();
        metrics.put("heapUsed", heapUsage.getUsed());
        metrics.put("heapMax", heapUsage.getMax());
        metrics.put("heapUsagePercent", 
            (double) heapUsage.getUsed() / heapUsage.getMax() * 100);
        
        // 线程使用情况
        ThreadMXBean threadBean = ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean();
        metrics.put("threadCount", threadBean.getThreadCount());
        metrics.put("peakThreadCount", threadBean.getPeakThreadCount());
        
        // GC情况
        long totalGcTime = ManagementFactory.getGarbageCollectorMXBeans()
            .stream()
            .mapToLong(GarbageCollectorMXBean::getCollectionTime)
            .sum();
        metrics.put("totalGcTime", totalGcTime);
        
        return metrics;
    }
}

导入导出批量数据文档，如何保证稳定快速？ ▶

批量数据导入导出系统设计方案

1. 系统架构设计：

  • 分层架构：控制层、服务层、数据访问层
  • 异步处理：使用消息队列处理大批量任务
  • 分片处理：将大文件拆分成小批次处理
  • 状态管理：实时跟踪处理进度和状态
  • 错误恢复：支持断点续传和失败重试

2. 导入系统核心实现：

// 批量导入服务
@Service
public class BatchImportService {
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private DataMapper dataMapper;
    
    /**
     * 启动批量导入任务
     * @param file 上传的文件
     * @param batchSize 批次大小
     * @return 任务ID
     */
    public String startImport(MultipartFile file, int batchSize) {
        String taskId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        
        // 1. 文件验证
        if (!validateFile(file)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("文件格式不正确");
        }
        
        // 2. 保存文件到临时目录
        String filePath = saveToTempDirectory(file, taskId);
        
        // 3. 分析文件，计算总行数
        long totalRows = countFileRows(filePath);
        
        // 4. 创建任务记录
        ImportTask task = new ImportTask();
        task.setTaskId(taskId);
        task.setFilePath(filePath);
        task.setTotalRows(totalRows);
        task.setBatchSize(batchSize);
        task.setStatus(TaskStatus.PENDING);
        task.setCreateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
        
        // 5. 保存任务状态到Redis
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("import_task:" + taskId, task, 24, TimeUnit.HOURS);
        
        // 6. 分片处理，发送到消息队列
        long totalBatches = (totalRows + batchSize - 1) / batchSize;
        for (long i = 0; i < totalBatches; i++) {
            BatchMessage message = new BatchMessage();
            message.setTaskId(taskId);
            message.setBatchIndex(i);
            message.setStartRow(i * batchSize);
            message.setEndRow(Math.min((i + 1) * batchSize - 1, totalRows - 1));
            
            rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend("import.queue", message);
        }
        
        return taskId;
    }
    
    /**
     * 处理单个批次
     */
    @RabbitListener(queues = "import.queue")
    public void processBatch(BatchMessage message) {
        String taskId = message.getTaskId();
        
        try {
            // 1. 获取任务信息
            ImportTask task = (ImportTask) redisTemplate.opsForValue()
                .get("import_task:" + taskId);
            
            if (task == null || task.getStatus() == TaskStatus.CANCELLED) {
                return; // 任务已取消
            }
            
            // 2. 读取批次数据
            List<DataRecord> records = readBatchData(task.getFilePath(), 
                message.getStartRow(), message.getEndRow());
            
            // 3. 数据验证和清洗
            List<DataRecord> validRecords = validateAndCleanData(records);
            
            // 4. 批量插入数据库
            if (!validRecords.isEmpty()) {
                dataMapper.batchInsert(validRecords);
            }
            
            // 5. 更新进度
            updateProgress(taskId, message.getBatchIndex(), validRecords.size());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // 记录错误并重试
            handleBatchError(message, e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 数据验证和清洗
     */
    private List<DataRecord> validateAndCleanData(List<DataRecord> records) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(this::isValidRecord)
            .map(this::cleanRecord)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    
    private boolean isValidRecord(DataRecord record) {
        // 数据验证逻辑：非空检查、格式验证、业务规则验证
        return record.getName() != null && 
               record.getName().length() <= 100 &&
               record.getEmail() != null &&
               record.getEmail().matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$");
    }
    
    private DataRecord cleanRecord(DataRecord record) {
        // 数据清洗：去除空格、统一格式等
        record.setName(record.getName().trim());
        record.setEmail(record.getEmail().toLowerCase().trim());
        return record;
    }
}

3. 导出系统核心实现：

// 批量导出服务
@Service
public class BatchExportService {
    
    @Autowired
    private DataMapper dataMapper;
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    /**
     * 启动批量导出任务
     * @param exportRequest 导出请求
     * @return 任务ID
     */
    public String startExport(ExportRequest exportRequest) {
        String taskId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        
        // 1. 计算总记录数
        long totalCount = dataMapper.countByCondition(exportRequest.getCondition());
        
        if (totalCount > 1000000) { // 超过100万条记录
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("导出数据量过大，请缩小查询范围");
        }
        
        // 2. 创建导出任务
        ExportTask task = new ExportTask();
        task.setTaskId(taskId);
        task.setTotalCount(totalCount);
        task.setStatus(TaskStatus.PROCESSING);
        task.setCreateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
        
        // 3. 保存任务状态
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("export_task:" + taskId, task, 24, TimeUnit.HOURS);
        
        // 4. 异步执行导出
        CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> executeExport(taskId, exportRequest));
        
        return taskId;
    }
    
    /**
     * 执行导出任务
     */
    private void executeExport(String taskId, ExportRequest request) {
        try {
            // 1. 创建临时文件
            String fileName = "export_" + taskId + ".xlsx";
            String filePath = "/tmp/exports/" + fileName;
            
            // 2. 使用EasyExcel进行流式写入
            try (ExcelWriter excelWriter = EasyExcel.write(filePath, DataRecord.class).build()) {
                WriteSheet writeSheet = EasyExcel.writerSheet("数据").build();
                
                // 3. 分页查询并写入
                int pageSize = 10000; // 每次处理1万条
                int pageNum = 1;
                long processedCount = 0;
                
                while (true) {
                    List<DataRecord> records = dataMapper.selectByCondition(
                        request.getCondition(), pageNum, pageSize);
                    
                    if (records.isEmpty()) {
                        break;
                    }
                    
                    // 4. 写入Excel
                    excelWriter.write(records, writeSheet);
                    
                    // 5. 更新进度
                    processedCount += records.size();
                    updateExportProgress(taskId, processedCount);
                    
                    pageNum++;
                    
                    // 6. 避免内存溢出，强制GC
                    if (pageNum % 10 == 0) {
                        System.gc();
                        Thread.sleep(100); // 短暂休息
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // 7. 上传到文件服务器或云存储
            String downloadUrl = uploadToFileServer(filePath);
            
            // 8. 更新任务状态为完成
            completeExportTask(taskId, downloadUrl);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // 标记任务失败
            failExportTask(taskId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

4. 性能优化策略：

  • 内存优化：流式处理，避免一次性加载大量数据
  • 数据库优化：批量操作、索引优化、分页查询
  • 并发控制：限制同时处理的任务数量
  • 缓存策略：缓存查询结果和中间数据
  • 压缩传输：文件压缩减少网络传输时间

5. 稳定性保障：

// 错误处理和重试机制
@Component
public class TaskRetryHandler {
    
    private static final int MAX_RETRY_COUNT = 3;
    
    @Retryable(value = {Exception.class}, 
                maxAttempts = MAX_RETRY_COUNT,
                backoff = @Backoff(delay = 2000, multiplier = 2))
    public void retryFailedBatch(BatchMessage message) {
        // 重试失败的批次处理
        processBatchWithRetry(message);
    }
    
    @Recover
    public void recover(Exception e, BatchMessage message) {
        // 最终失败处理：记录错误日志，通知管理员
        logger.error("批次处理最终失败: taskId={}, batchIndex={}", 
            message.getTaskId(), message.getBatchIndex(), e);
        
        // 标记该批次为失败状态
        markBatchAsFailed(message.getTaskId(), message.getBatchIndex());
    }
}

// 断点续传支持
@Service
public class ResumeService {
    
    /**
     * 恢复中断的导入任务
     */
    public void resumeImportTask(String taskId) {
        // 1. 获取任务状态
        ImportTask task = getTaskFromRedis(taskId);
        
        if (task == null || task.getStatus() == TaskStatus.COMPLETED) {
            return;
        }
        
        // 2. 查找未处理的批次
        Set<Long> processedBatches = getProcessedBatches(taskId);
        long totalBatches = (task.getTotalRows() + task.getBatchSize() - 1) / task.getBatchSize();
        
        // 3. 重新发送未处理的批次到队列
        for (long i = 0; i < totalBatches; i++) {
            if (!processedBatches.contains(i)) {
                BatchMessage message = createBatchMessage(task, i);
                rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend("import.queue", message);
            }
        }
    }
}

6. 监控和告警：

  • 任务监控：实时监控任务进度和状态
  • 性能监控：监控处理速度、内存使用、数据库连接
  • 错误告警：任务失败、超时、异常自动告警
  • 资源告警：磁盘空间、内存使用率告警
  • 业务指标：成功率、平均处理时间等

7. 配置建议：

  • 批次大小：导入1000-5000条/批次，导出10000条/批次
  • 线程池：核心线程数=CPU核数，最大线程数=CPU核数*2
  • 数据库连接池：最小10个，最大50个连接
  • 内存配置：JVM堆内存至少4GB，预留2GB系统内存
  • 文件存储：使用SSD存储，定期清理临时文件
上传大文件和视频，如何保证快速稳定上传？ ▶

大文件上传系统设计方案

1. 系统架构设计：

  • 分片上传：将大文件切分成小块并行上传
  • 断点续传：支持上传中断后从断点继续
  • 秒传功能：基于文件MD5实现秒传
  • 多线程上传：并发上传多个分片提高速度
  • 进度监控：实时显示上传进度和状态

2. 前端分片上传实现：

// JavaScript分片上传组件
class ChunkUploader {
    constructor(options) {
        this.file = options.file;
        this.chunkSize = options.chunkSize || 2 * 1024 * 1024; // 2MB per chunk
        this.concurrent = options.concurrent || 3; // 并发数
        this.uploadUrl = options.uploadUrl;
        this.onProgress = options.onProgress;
        this.onComplete = options.onComplete;
        this.onError = options.onError;
        
        this.chunks = [];
        this.uploadedChunks = new Set();
        this.fileHash = null;
    }
    
    // 计算文件MD5
    async calculateFileHash() {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const spark = new SparkMD5.ArrayBuffer();
            const fileReader = new FileReader();
            const chunks = Math.ceil(this.file.size / this.chunkSize);
            let currentChunk = 0;
            
            fileReader.onload = (e) => {
                spark.append(e.target.result);
                currentChunk++;
                
                if (currentChunk < chunks) {
                    loadNext();
                } else {
                    resolve(spark.end());
                }
            };
            
            function loadNext() {
                const start = currentChunk * this.chunkSize;
                const end = Math.min(start + this.chunkSize, this.file.size);
                fileReader.readAsArrayBuffer(this.file.slice(start, end));
            }
            
            loadNext();
        });
    }
    
    // 创建分片
    createChunks() {
        const chunks = Math.ceil(this.file.size / this.chunkSize);
        
        for (let i = 0; i < chunks; i++) {
            const start = i * this.chunkSize;
            const end = Math.min(start + this.chunkSize, this.file.size);
            
            this.chunks.push({
                index: i,
                start: start,
                end: end,
                blob: this.file.slice(start, end),
                size: end - start,
                uploaded: false
            });
        }
    }
    
    // 检查文件是否已存在（秒传）
    async checkFileExists() {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/file/check`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                fileHash: this.fileHash,
                fileName: this.file.name,
                fileSize: this.file.size
            })
        });
        
        return await response.json();
    }
    
    // 获取已上传的分片
    async getUploadedChunks() {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/file/chunks?fileHash=${this.fileHash}`);
        const result = await response.json();
        
        if (result.uploadedChunks) {
            result.uploadedChunks.forEach(index => {
                this.uploadedChunks.add(index);
                this.chunks[index].uploaded = true;
            });
        }
    }
    
    // 上传单个分片
    async uploadChunk(chunk) {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('chunk', chunk.blob);
        formData.append('chunkIndex', chunk.index);
        formData.append('fileHash', this.fileHash);
        formData.append('fileName', this.file.name);
        formData.append('totalChunks', this.chunks.length);
        
        const response = await fetch(this.uploadUrl, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
        });
        
        if (response.ok) {
            chunk.uploaded = true;
            this.uploadedChunks.add(chunk.index);
            this.updateProgress();
        } else {
            throw new Error(`分片${chunk.index}上传失败`);
        }
    }
    
    // 开始上传
    async start() {
        try {
            // 1. 计算文件哈希
            this.fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash();
            
            // 2. 检查文件是否已存在
            const existsResult = await this.checkFileExists();
            if (existsResult.exists) {
                this.onComplete(existsResult.fileUrl);
                return;
            }
            
            // 3. 创建分片
            this.createChunks();
            
            // 4. 获取已上传的分片（断点续传）
            await this.getUploadedChunks();
            
            // 5. 并发上传分片
            const pendingChunks = this.chunks.filter(chunk => !chunk.uploaded);
            await this.uploadChunksConcurrently(pendingChunks);
            
            // 6. 合并分片
            await this.mergeChunks();
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.onError(error);
        }
    }
}

3. 后端分片处理实现：

// Spring Boot分片上传控制器
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/file")
public class FileUploadController {
    
    @Autowired
    private ChunkUploadService chunkUploadService;
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    /**
     * 检查文件是否已存在（秒传）
     */
    @PostMapping("/check")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> checkFile(@RequestBody FileCheckRequest request) {
        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        
        // 根据文件哈希查询文件是否已存在
        FileRecord existingFile = chunkUploadService.findByHash(request.getFileHash());
        
        if (existingFile != null) {
            result.put("exists", true);
            result.put("fileUrl", existingFile.getFileUrl());
        } else {
            result.put("exists", false);
        }
        
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取已上传的分片信息
     */
    @GetMapping("/chunks")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getUploadedChunks(@RequestParam String fileHash) {
        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        
        // 从Redis获取已上传的分片信息
        Set<Object> uploadedChunks = redisTemplate.opsForSet()
            .members("uploaded_chunks:" + fileHash);
        
        result.put("uploadedChunks", uploadedChunks);
        
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }
    
    /**
     * 上传分片
     */
    @PostMapping("/upload")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> uploadChunk(
            @RequestParam("chunk") MultipartFile chunk,
            @RequestParam("chunkIndex") int chunkIndex,
            @RequestParam("fileHash") String fileHash,
            @RequestParam("fileName") String fileName,
            @RequestParam("totalChunks") int totalChunks) {
        
        try {
            // 1. 保存分片到临时目录
            String chunkPath = chunkUploadService.saveChunk(chunk, fileHash, chunkIndex);
            
            // 2. 记录已上传的分片
            redisTemplate.opsForSet().add("uploaded_chunks:" + fileHash, chunkIndex);
            
            // 3. 检查是否所有分片都已上传
            long uploadedCount = redisTemplate.opsForSet()
                .size("uploaded_chunks:" + fileHash);
            
            Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
            result.put("success", true);
            result.put("chunkIndex", chunkIndex);
            
            // 4. 如果所有分片都已上传，触发合并
            if (uploadedCount == totalChunks) {
                // 异步合并分片
                CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
                    try {
                        String finalFilePath = chunkUploadService.mergeChunks(fileHash, fileName, totalChunks);
                        
                        // 保存文件记录
                        FileRecord fileRecord = new FileRecord();
                        fileRecord.setFileHash(fileHash);
                        fileRecord.setFileName(fileName);
                        fileRecord.setFilePath(finalFilePath);
                        fileRecord.setFileUrl(generateFileUrl(finalFilePath));
                        fileRecord.setUploadTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                        
                        chunkUploadService.saveFileRecord(fileRecord);
                        
                        // 清理临时文件和Redis记录
                        chunkUploadService.cleanupTempFiles(fileHash);
                        redisTemplate.delete("uploaded_chunks:" + fileHash);
                        
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        logger.error("合并分片失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
                    }
                });
                
                result.put("allUploaded", true);
            }
            
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.error("分片上传失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(500).body(Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }
}

4. 分片合并服务：

// 分片上传服务
@Service
public class ChunkUploadService {
    
    private static final String TEMP_DIR = "/tmp/chunks/";
    private static final String UPLOAD_DIR = "/uploads/";
    
    @Autowired
    private FileRecordMapper fileRecordMapper;
    
    /**
     * 保存分片文件
     */
    public String saveChunk(MultipartFile chunk, String fileHash, int chunkIndex) throws IOException {
        // 创建临时目录
        String tempDirPath = TEMP_DIR + fileHash + "/";
        File tempDir = new File(tempDirPath);
        if (!tempDir.exists()) {
            tempDir.mkdirs();
        }
        
        // 保存分片文件
        String chunkFileName = "chunk_" + chunkIndex;
        String chunkPath = tempDirPath + chunkFileName;
        
        chunk.transferTo(new File(chunkPath));
        
        return chunkPath;
    }
    
    /**
     * 合并分片文件
     */
    public String mergeChunks(String fileHash, String fileName, int totalChunks) throws IOException {
        // 创建最终文件目录
        String uploadDirPath = UPLOAD_DIR + LocalDate.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE) + "/";
        File uploadDir = new File(uploadDirPath);
        if (!uploadDir.exists()) {
            uploadDir.mkdirs();
        }
        
        // 生成最终文件路径
        String finalFileName = fileHash + "_" + fileName;
        String finalFilePath = uploadDirPath + finalFileName;
        
        // 合并分片
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(finalFilePath);
             FileChannel outChannel = fos.getChannel()) {
            
            for (int i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) {
                String chunkPath = TEMP_DIR + fileHash + "/chunk_" + i;
                
                try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(chunkPath);
                     FileChannel inChannel = fis.getChannel()) {
                    
                    // 使用NIO零拷贝技术提高合并效率
                    inChannel.transferTo(0, inChannel.size(), outChannel);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 验证合并后的文件
        if (!validateMergedFile(finalFilePath, fileHash)) {
            throw new IOException("文件合并后校验失败");
        }
        
        return finalFilePath;
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证合并后的文件
     */
    private boolean validateMergedFile(String filePath, String expectedHash) {
        try {
            String actualHash = calculateFileHash(filePath);
            return expectedHash.equals(actualHash);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.error("文件校验失败: {}", e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算文件MD5哈希
     */
    private String calculateFileHash(String filePath) throws Exception {
        try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(filePath)) {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int bytesRead;
            
            while ((bytesRead = fis.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                md.update(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
            }
            
            byte[] hashBytes = md.digest();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (byte b : hashBytes) {
                sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            }
            
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 清理临时文件
     */
    public void cleanupTempFiles(String fileHash) {
        String tempDirPath = TEMP_DIR + fileHash;
        File tempDir = new File(tempDirPath);
        
        if (tempDir.exists() && tempDir.isDirectory()) {
            File[] files = tempDir.listFiles();
            if (files != null) {
                for (File file : files) {
                    file.delete();
                }
            }
            tempDir.delete();
        }
    }
}

5. 性能优化策略：

  • 分片大小优化：根据网络状况动态调整分片大小（1-5MB）
  • 并发控制：限制同时上传的分片数量，避免网络拥塞
  • 压缩传输：对文本类文件进行压缩传输
  • CDN加速：使用CDN节点就近上传
  • 网络重试：网络异常时自动重试

6. 视频文件特殊处理：

// 视频文件处理服务
@Service
public class VideoUploadService {
    
    /**
     * 视频文件上传后处理
     */
    @Async
    public void processVideoFile(String filePath, String fileHash) {
        try {
            // 1. 生成视频缩略图
            String thumbnailPath = generateThumbnail(filePath);
            
            // 2. 获取视频信息
            VideoInfo videoInfo = extractVideoInfo(filePath);
            
            // 3. 转码处理（可选）
            if (needTranscode(videoInfo)) {
                String transcodedPath = transcodeVideo(filePath, videoInfo);
                // 更新文件路径为转码后的路径
                updateFileRecord(fileHash, transcodedPath);
            }
            
            // 4. 上传到云存储
            String cloudUrl = uploadToCloud(filePath);
            updateFileRecord(fileHash, cloudUrl);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.error("视频处理失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成视频缩略图
     */
    private String generateThumbnail(String videoPath) {
        // 使用FFmpeg生成缩略图
        String thumbnailPath = videoPath.replace(".mp4", "_thumb.jpg");
        
        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(
            "ffmpeg", "-i", videoPath, 
            "-ss", "00:00:01", "vframes", "1", 
            "-q:v", "2", thumbnailPath
        );
        
        try {
            Process process = pb.start();
            process.waitFor();
            return thumbnailPath;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.error("生成缩略图失败: {}", e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }
}

9.8 网络协议对比

HTTP、MQTT、SSE等协议的区别和应用场景？ ▶

网络协议对比分析

一、协议概述对比

协议 全称 传输层 连接方式 主要特点
HTTP HyperText Transfer Protocol TCP 请求-响应 无状态、无连接
MQTT Message Queuing Telemetry Transport TCP 发布-订阅 轻量级、低带宽
SSE Server-Sent Events TCP 单向推送 服务器主动推送
WebSocket WebSocket Protocol TCP 全双工 持久连接、双向通信
CoAP Constrained Application Protocol UDP 请求-响应 轻量级、低功耗

二、详细协议分析

1. HTTP协议
// HTTP请求示例
// 客户端代码
@RestController
public class HttpClientController {
    
    @Autowired
    private RestTemplate restTemplate;
    
    // GET请求
    @GetMapping("/http/get")
    public String httpGet() {
        String url = "https://api.example.com/users";
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.getForEntity(url, String.class);
        return response.getBody();
    }
    
    // POST请求
    @PostMapping("/http/post")
    public String httpPost(@RequestBody User user) {
        String url = "https://api.example.com/users";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        
        HttpEntity<User> entity = new HttpEntity<>(user, headers);
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.postForEntity(url, entity, String.class);
        return response.getBody();
    }
}

HTTP特点：

  • 无状态：每个请求都是独立的，服务器不保存客户端状态
  • 无连接：请求完成后连接关闭
  • 基于请求-响应：客户端发起请求，服务器返回响应
  • 应用场景：Web页面、RESTful API、文件传输
2. MQTT协议
// MQTT客户端实现
@Component
public class MqttClient {
    
    private MqttClient mqttClient;
    
    @PostConstruct
    public void init() throws MqttException {
        // 连接到MQTT代理
        mqttClient = new MqttClient("tcp://localhost:1883", "JavaClient");
        MqttConnectOptions options = new MqttConnectOptions();
        options.setCleanSession(true);
        options.setKeepAliveInterval(60);
        
        mqttClient.connect(options);
        
        // 订阅主题
        mqttClient.subscribe("sensor/temperature", new IMqttMessageListener() {
            @Override
            public void messageArrived(String topic, MqttMessage message) throws Exception {
                String payload = new String(message.getPayload());
                System.out.println("收到消息: " + topic + " - " + payload);
            }
        });
    }
    
    // 发布消息
    public void publish(String topic, String message) throws MqttException {
        MqttMessage mqttMessage = new MqttMessage(message.getBytes());
        mqttMessage.setQos(1); // 至少一次传递
        mqttClient.publish(topic, mqttMessage);
    }
}

MQTT特点：

  • 轻量级：协议开销小，适合带宽受限环境
  • 发布-订阅模式：支持一对多消息分发
  • QoS保证：提供三种服务质量等级
  • 应用场景：物联网设备、移动应用、实时数据采集
3. SSE协议
// SSE服务器端实现
@RestController
public class SseController {
    
    private final Map<String, SseEmitter> emitters = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    
    // 建立SSE连接
    @GetMapping("/sse/connect")
    public SseEmitter connect(@RequestParam String clientId) {
        SseEmitter emitter = new SseEmitter(Long.MAX_VALUE);
        
        // 连接建立时的处理
        emitter.onCompletion(() -> emitters.remove(clientId));
        emitter.onTimeout(() -> emitters.remove(clientId));
        emitter.onError(throwable -> emitters.remove(clientId));
        
        emitters.put(clientId, emitter);
        
        return emitter;
    }
    
    // 推送消息到指定客户端
    @PostMapping("/sse/push")
    public String pushMessage(@RequestParam String clientId, 
                               @RequestParam String message) {
        SseEmitter emitter = emitters.get(clientId);
        if (emitter != null) {
            try {
                emitter.send(SseEmitter.event()
                    .name("message")
                    .data(message));
                return "消息推送成功";
            } catch (IOException e) {
                emitters.remove(clientId);
                return "推送失败";
            }
        }
        return "客户端未连接";
    }
}

SSE特点：

  • 单向通信：服务器向客户端推送数据
  • 自动重连：连接断开时浏览器自动重连
  • 简单易用：基于HTTP协议，无需额外协议
  • 应用场景：实时通知、股票行情、聊天应用
4. WebSocket协议
// WebSocket服务器端实现
@Component
@ServerEndpoint("/websocket")
public class WebSocketServer {
    
    private static final Set<Session> sessions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>().newKeySet();
    
    // 连接建立
    @OnOpen
    public void onOpen(Session session) {
        sessions.add(session);
        System.out.println("客户端连接: " + session.getId());
        
        try {
            session.getBasicRemote().sendText("连接成功");
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
    
    // 接收消息
    @OnMessage
    public void onMessage(String message, Session session) {
        System.out.println("收到消息: " + message);
        
        // 广播消息给所有客户端
        for (Session s : sessions) {
            try {
                if (s.isOpen()) {
                    s.getBasicRemote().sendText("广播: " + message);
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                sessions.remove(s);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 连接关闭
    @OnClose
    public void onClose(Session session) {
        sessions.remove(session);
        System.out.println("客户端断开: " + session.getId());
    }
    
    // 错误处理
    @OnError
    public void onError(Session session, Throwable error) {
        sessions.remove(session);
        error.printStackTrace();
    }
}

WebSocket特点：

  • 全双工通信：客户端和服务器可以同时发送数据
  • 持久连接：连接建立后保持打开状态
  • 低延迟：无需HTTP握手开销
  • 应用场景：在线游戏、实时聊天、协作编辑
5. CoAP协议
// CoAP客户端实现
@Component
public class CoapClient {
    
    private CoapClient coapClient;
    
    @PostConstruct
    public void init() {
        coapClient = new CoapClient();
    }
    
    // GET请求
    public String getResource(String uri) {
        CoapResponse response = coapClient.get(uri);
        if (response != null) {
            return response.getResponseText();
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    // POST请求
    public String postResource(String uri, String payload) {
        Request request = new Request(Code.POST);
        request.setURI(uri);
        request.setPayload(payload);
        request.getOptions().setContentFormat(MediaTypeRegistry.APPLICATION_JSON);
        
        CoapResponse response = coapClient.advanced(request).waitForResponse();
        if (response != null) {
            return response.getResponseText();
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    // 观察资源变化
    public void observeResource(String uri) {
        CoapObserveRelation relation = coapClient.observe(new CoapHandler() {
            @Override
            public void onLoad(CoapResponse response) {
                System.out.println("资源更新: " + response.getResponseText());
            }
            
            @Override
            public void onError() {
                System.out.println("观察失败");
            }
        });
    }
}

CoAP特点：

  • 轻量级：专为受限设备设计
  • 基于UDP：减少网络开销
  • RESTful：类似HTTP的请求-响应模式
  • 应用场景：物联网传感器、智能家居、工业自动化

三、协议选择指南

场景 推荐协议 理由
Web API HTTP 标准协议，广泛支持
物联网设备 MQTT/CoAP 低功耗，轻量级
实时通知 SSE 简单易用，自动重连
双向通信 WebSocket 全双工，低延迟
受限环境 CoAP 最小资源消耗

四、性能对比

  • 延迟：WebSocket < SSE < HTTP < MQTT < CoAP
  • 带宽消耗：CoAP < MQTT < HTTP < SSE < WebSocket
  • 实现复杂度：HTTP < SSE < MQTT < WebSocket < CoAP
  • 连接数支持：HTTP > SSE > WebSocket > MQTT > CoAP

        // Kafka消费者配置
        @Component
        public class DeviceDataConsumer {
            
            @Autowired
            private InfluxDBTemplate influxDBTemplate;
            
            @KafkaListener(topics = "device-data-topic", groupId = "ems-data-group")
            public void handleDeviceData(ConsumerRecord record) {
                String deviceId = record.key();
                DeviceData data = record.value();
                
                // 存储到时序数据库
                Point point = Point.measurement("device_metrics")
                    .tag("device_id", deviceId)
                    .tag("device_type", data.getDeviceType())
                    .addField("voltage", data.getVoltage())
                    .addField("current", data.getCurrent())
                    .addField("power", data.getPower())
                    .addField("temperature", data.getTemperature())
                    .time(System.currentTimeMillis(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    .build();
                    
                influxDBTemplate.write(point);
                
                // 实时告警检测
                checkAlarms(deviceId, data);
            }
            
            private void checkAlarms(String deviceId, DeviceData data) {
                if (data.getTemperature() > 60) {
                    // 发送高温告警
                    AlarmEvent alarm = new AlarmEvent(deviceId, "HIGH_TEMPERATURE", data.getTemperature());
                    kafkaTemplate.send("alarm-topic", alarm);
                }
            }
        }

        @Service
        public class ModbusService {
            
            private ModbusMaster modbusMaster;
            
            @PostConstruct
            public void initModbus() {
                IpParameters params = new IpParameters();
                params.setHost("192.168.1.100");
                params.setPort(502);
                
                modbusMaster = new ModbusMasterImpl(params);
                try {
                    modbusMaster.connect();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("Modbus连接失败", e);
                }
            }
            
            public List readHoldingRegisters(int slaveId, int offset, int numberOfRegisters) {
                try {
                    ReadHoldingRegistersRequest request = new ReadHoldingRegistersRequest(slaveId, offset, numberOfRegisters);
                    ReadHoldingRegistersResponse response = (ReadHoldingRegistersResponse) modbusMaster.sendRequest(request);
                    return Arrays.stream(response.getRegisters()).boxed().collect(Collectors.toList());
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("读取Modbus寄存器失败", e);
                    return Collections.emptyList();
                }
            }
        }

        // 698协议解析
        @Component
        public class Protocol698Parser {
            
            public DeviceData parse698Frame(byte[] frame) {
                // 698协议帧结构解析
                if (frame.length < 8) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("698协议帧长度不足");
                }
                
                // 帧头检查
                if (frame[0] != 0x68) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("698协议帧头错误");
                }
                
                // 长度字段
                int length = ((frame[1] & 0xFF) << 8) | (frame[2] & 0xFF);
                
                // 控制字段
                byte control = frame[3];
                
                // 地址字段
                byte[] address = Arrays.copyOfRange(frame, 4, 10);
                
                // 数据字段解析
                byte[] data = Arrays.copyOfRange(frame, 10, frame.length - 2);
                
                return parseDataField(data);
            }
            
            private DeviceData parseDataField(byte[] data) {
                DeviceData deviceData = new DeviceData();
                // 根据698协议规范解析具体数据项

                return deviceData;
            }
        }
Golang EMS架构设计 ▶ 
// Golang微服务架构
        package main

        import (
            "context"
            "log"
            "net/http"
            "time"
            
            "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
            "github.com/go-redis/redis/v8"
            "gorm.io/gorm"
        )

        // EMS核心服务结构
        type EMSService struct {
            db          *gorm.DB
            redis       *redis.Client
            mqttClient  MQTTClient
            deviceMgr   *DeviceManager
        }

        // 设备管理器
        type DeviceManager struct {
            devices map[string]*Device
            mutex   sync.RWMutex
        }

        type Device struct {
            ID          string    `json:"id"`
            Type        string    `json:"type"`
            Status      string    `json:"status"`
            LastSeen    time.Time `json:"last_seen"`
            Metrics     *Metrics  `json:"metrics"`
        }

        type Metrics struct {
            Voltage     float64 `json:"voltage"`
            Current     float64 `json:"current"`
            Power       float64 `json:"power"`
            Temperature float64 `json:"temperature"`
            SOC         float64 `json:"soc"` // 电池荷电状态
            SOH         float64 `json:"soh"` // 电池健康状态
        }

        // 实时数据处理
        func (ems *EMSService) ProcessDeviceData(ctx context.Context, deviceID string, data *Metrics) error {
            // 更新设备状态
            ems.deviceMgr.UpdateDevice(deviceID, data)
            
            // 缓存到Redis
            key := fmt.Sprintf("device:%s:metrics", deviceID)
            err := ems.redis.HMSet(ctx, key, map[string]interface{}{
                "voltage":     data.Voltage,
                "current":     data.Current,
                "power":       data.Power,
                "temperature": data.Temperature,
                "soc":         data.SOC,
                "soh":         data.SOH,
                "timestamp":   time.Now().Unix(),
            }).Err()
            
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("缓存设备数据失败: %w", err)
            }
            
            // 设置过期时间
            ems.redis.Expire(ctx, key, 5*time.Minute)
            
            // 检查告警条件
            ems.checkAlarms(deviceID, data)
            
            return nil
        }

        // 告警检测
        func (ems *EMSService) checkAlarms(deviceID string, data *Metrics) {
            alarms := []string{}
            
            if data.Temperature > 60 {
                alarms = append(alarms, "HIGH_TEMPERATURE")
            }
            
            if data.Voltage > 800 || data.Voltage < 200 {
                alarms = append(alarms, "VOLTAGE_ABNORMAL")
            }
            
            if data.SOC < 10 {
                alarms = append(alarms, "LOW_BATTERY")
            }
            
            if data.SOH < 80 {
                alarms = append(alarms, "BATTERY_DEGRADATION")
            }
            
            for _, alarm := range alarms {
                ems.sendAlarm(deviceID, alarm, data)
            }
        }
Angular前端开发 ▶ 
// Angular EMS监控组件
        import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
        import { WebSocketService } from '../services/websocket.service';
        import { DeviceService } from '../services/device.service';

        @Component({
        selector: 'app-ems-dashboard',
        templateUrl: './ems-dashboard.component.html',
        styleUrls: ['./ems-dashboard.component.scss']
        })
        export class EmsDashboardComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
        
        devices: Device[] = [];
        realTimeData: Map = new Map();
        alarms: Alarm[] = [];
        
        constructor(
            private websocketService: WebSocketService,
            private deviceService: DeviceService
        ) {}
        
        ngOnInit(): void {
            this.loadDevices();
            this.subscribeToRealTimeData();
        }
        
        ngOnDestroy(): void {
            this.websocketService.disconnect();
        }
        
        private loadDevices(): void {
            this.deviceService.getDevices().subscribe(devices => {
            this.devices = devices;
            });
        }
        
        private subscribeToRealTimeData(): void {
            this.websocketService.connect('ws://localhost:8080/ws/device-data');
            
            this.websocketService.onMessage().subscribe(message => {
            const data = JSON.parse(message);
            
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'DEVICE_METRICS':
                this.updateDeviceMetrics(data.deviceId, data.metrics);
                break;
                case 'ALARM':
                this.handleAlarm(data.alarm);
                break;
            }
            });
        }
        
        private updateDeviceMetrics(deviceId: string, metrics: DeviceMetrics): void {
            this.realTimeData.set(deviceId, metrics);
            
            // 更新图表数据
            this.updateCharts(deviceId, metrics);
        }
        
        private handleAlarm(alarm: Alarm): void {
            this.alarms.unshift(alarm);
            
            // 显示告警通知
            this.showAlarmNotification(alarm);
        }
        }

        // 设备服务
        import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
        import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
        import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

        @Injectable({
        providedIn: 'root'
        })
        export class DeviceService {
        
        private apiUrl = '/api/device';
        
        constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}
        
        getDevices(): Observable {
            return this.http.get(`${this.apiUrl}/list`);
        }
        
        getDeviceStatus(deviceId: string): Observable {
            return this.http.get(`${this.apiUrl}/status/${deviceId}`);
        }
        
        controlDevice(deviceId: string, command: DeviceCommand): Observable {
            return this.http.post(`${this.apiUrl}/control/${deviceId}`, command);
        }
        
        getHistoricalData(deviceId: string, timeRange: TimeRange): Observable {
            return this.http.get(`${this.apiUrl}/history/${deviceId}`, {
            params: {
                start: timeRange.start.toISOString(),
                end: timeRange.end.toISOString()
            }
            });
        }
        }
JVM调优与Docker部署 ▶ 
// JVM调优参数
        生产环境JVM配置：
        -Xms4g -Xmx8g                    # 堆内存设置
        -XX:+UseZGC                      # 使用ZGC垃圾收集器
        -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions # 启用实验性选项
        -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200         # 最大GC暂停时间
        -XX:+UseCompressedOops           # 压缩对象指针
        -XX:+UseCompressedClassPointers  # 压缩类指针
        -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote=true                    # 启用JMX
        -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999               # JMX端口
        -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false      # JMX认证
        -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false               # JMX SSL
        -Dspring.profiles.active=prod                          # 生产环境配置

        // Dockerfile多阶段构建
        # 构建阶段
        FROM openjdk:17-jdk-alpine AS builder
        WORKDIR /app
        COPY pom.xml .
        COPY src ./src
        RUN ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests

        # 运行阶段
        FROM openjdk:17-jre-alpine
        WORKDIR /app

        # 创建非root用户
        RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S ems && \
            adduser -S ems -u 1001 -G ems

        # 复制应用程序
        COPY --from=builder /app/target/ems-service-*.jar app.jar

        # 设置权限
        RUN chown -R ems:ems /app
        USER ems

        # 健康检查
        HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
            CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/actuator/health || exit 1

        # 启动应用
        EXPOSE 8080
        ENTRYPOINT ["java", \
            "-Xms2g", "-Xmx4g", \
            "-XX:+UseZGC", \
            "-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions", \
            "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote=true", \
            "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999", \
            "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false", \
            "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false", \
            "-Dspring.profiles.active=prod", \
            "-jar", "app.jar"]

EMS面试重点题目 ▶ 
// 1. EMS系统核心概念
        问题：什么是EMS储能管理系统？主要功能有哪些？
        答案：
        EMS（Energy Management System）是集监控、控制、分析和优化于一体的智能系统
        主要功能包括：
        - 实时监控：电池SOC/SOH、电压电流、温度等参数
        - 智能控制：充放电策略优化、功率调节
        - 安全管理：过温保护、过充过放保护、电池均衡
        - 数据分析：历史数据分析、性能评估、故障预测
        - 通信接口：与电网调度、分布式能源系统对接

        // 2. 技术架构设计
        问题：如何设计支持千万级设备接入的EMS架构？
        答案：
        1. 分层架构：设备层、通信层、服务层、应用层
        2. 微服务拆分：按业务域拆分为设备、数据、告警等服务
        3. 消息中间件：Kafka处理高并发数据流，MQTT支持设备通信
        4. 负载均衡：网关层实现请求分发和限流
        5. 数据分片：按设备ID或时间维度分片存储
        6. 缓存策略：Redis缓存热点数据，减少数据库压力
        7. 容器化部署：Kubernetes实现弹性扩缩容

        // 3. 消息积压处理
        问题：如何解决分布式场景下的消息积压和重复消费问题？
        答案：
        消息积压解决方案：
        - 增加消费者实例数量，提高并行处理能力
        - 优化消费逻辑，减少单条消息处理时间
        - 实现消息优先级队列，重要消息优先处理
        - 监控消费延迟，及时告警和扩容

        重复消费解决方案：
        - 实现幂等性：使用唯一ID去重
        - 数据库约束：设置唯一索引防止重复插入
        - Redis分布式锁：确保同一消息只被处理一次
        - 消费确认机制：处理成功后再提交offset

        // 4. 设备断连重试机制
        问题：如何设计设备断连重试和故障恢复机制？
        答案：
        1. 心跳检测：定期发送心跳包检测设备在线状态
        2. 指数退避重试：失败后按指数级增加重试间隔
        3. 断路器模式：连续失败后暂停重试，避免雪崩
        4. 离线消息队列：设备离线期间缓存指令
        5. 状态同步：设备重连后同步最新状态
        6. 告警通知：设备长时间离线触发告警

        // 5. 工业协议处理
        问题：Modbus、698、645协议的特点和应用场景？
        答案：
        Modbus协议：
        - 特点：简单可靠、广泛支持、主从架构
        - 应用：PLC、变频器、传感器通信
        - 实现：支持RTU、ASCII、TCP三种模式

        698协议（DL/T 698）：
        - 特点：电力行业标准、安全性高、支持加密
        - 应用：智能电表、电力监测设备
        - 实现：帧结构复杂，需要专门的解析器

        645协议（DL/T 645）：
        - 特点：电能表通信标准、数据格式固定
        - 应用：电能计量、抄表系统
        - 实现：BCD码编码，需要校验和验证

        // 6. 性能优化策略
        问题：EMS系统的性能优化策略有哪些？
        答案：
        1. JVM调优：
        - 使用ZGC或Shenandoah低延迟GC
        - 合理设置堆内存大小
        - 启用JMX监控

        2. 数据库优化：
        - 时序数据使用InfluxDB
        - 读写分离，主从复制
        - 合理设计索引

        3. 缓存策略：
        - Redis集群部署
        - 热点数据预加载
        - 缓存穿透保护

        4. 网络优化：
        - 连接池复用
        - 数据压缩传输
        - CDN加速静态资源

        5. 代码优化：
        - 异步处理非关键业务
        - 批量操作减少IO
        - 合理使用线程池

        // 2. 通信技术实现
        @Service
        public class CommunicationTechnologyService {
            
            // 串口通信
            public void serialCommunication(String portName, int baudRate) {
                SerialPort serialPort = SerialPort.getCommPort(portName);
                serialPort.setBaudRate(baudRate);
                serialPort.setComPortParameters(8, 1, 0); // 8数据位，1停止位，无校验
                
                if (serialPort.openPort()) {
                    // 数据读写操作
                    byte[] readBuffer = new byte[1024];
                    int numRead = serialPort.readBytes(readBuffer, readBuffer.length);
                    processSerialData(readBuffer, numRead);
                }
            }
            
            // CAN通信
            public void canCommunication() {
                CANInterface canInterface = new CANInterface();
                canInterface.initialize("can0", 500000); // 500kbps
                
                // CAN帧发送
                CANFrame frame = new CANFrame(0x123, new byte[]{0x01, 0x02, 0x03});
                canInterface.sendFrame(frame);
                
                // CAN帧接收
                CANFrame receivedFrame = canInterface.receiveFrame();
                processCANFrame(receivedFrame);
            }
            
            // 以太网通信
            public void ethernetCommunication() {
                // TCP/IP通信
                try (Socket socket = new Socket("192.168.1.100", 502)) {
                    OutputStream out = socket.getOutputStream();
                    InputStream in = socket.getInputStream();
                    
                    // Modbus TCP通信
                    byte[] modbusRequest = buildModbusRequest();
                    out.write(modbusRequest);
                    
                    byte[] response = new byte[1024];
                    int bytesRead = in.read(response);
                    processModbusResponse(response, bytesRead);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    log.error("以太网通信失败", e);
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. 工业协议实现
        @Component
        public class IndustrialProtocolHandler {
            
            // 电力103协议
            public void handle103Protocol(byte[] data) {
                // IEC 60870-5-103协议解析
                if (data.length < 6) return;
                
                byte startByte = data[0]; // 起始字符
                byte[] address = Arrays.copyOfRange(data, 1, 3); // 地址域
                byte functionCode = data[3]; // 功能码
                byte[] userData = Arrays.copyOfRange(data, 4, data.length - 2); // 用户数据
                byte checksum = data[data.length - 1]; // 校验和
                
                // 根据功能码处理不同类型的数据
                switch (functionCode) {
                    case 0x01: // 遥信数据
                        processDigitalInput(userData);
                        break;
                    case 0x02: // 遥测数据
                        processAnalogInput(userData);
                        break;
                    case 0x03: // 遥控命令
                        processControlCommand(userData);
                        break;
                }
            }
            
            // 电力104协议
            public void handle104Protocol(byte[] data) {
                // IEC 60870-5-104协议处理
                APDU apdu = parseAPDU(data);
                
                switch (apdu.getType()) {
                    case I_FORMAT: // 信息传输格式
                        processInformationTransfer(apdu);
                        break;
                    case S_FORMAT: // 监督功能格式
                        processSupervisoryFunction(apdu);
                        break;
                    case U_FORMAT: // 未编号控制功能格式
                        processUnnumberedControl(apdu);
                        break;
                }
            }
            
            // IEC61850 MMS协议
            public void handleIEC61850MMS() {
                // MMS (Manufacturing Message Specification) 处理
                MMSClient mmsClient = new MMSClient();
                mmsClient.connect("192.168.1.50", 102);
                
                // 读取逻辑节点数据
                String logicalNodeRef = "GGIO1.Ind1.stVal";
                MMSValue value = mmsClient.readVariable(logicalNodeRef);
                
                // 写入控制命令
                MMSValue controlValue = new MMSValue(true);
                mmsClient.writeVariable("GGIO1.SPCSO1.Oper.ctlVal", controlValue);
            }
        }
储能系统专业技术 ▶ 
// 微电网能量管理系统
        @Service
        public class MicrogridEnergyManagement {
            
            @Autowired
            private BatteryManagementService bmsService;
            
            @Autowired
            private PowerConversionService pcsService;
            
            @Autowired
            private LoadForecastService forecastService;
            
            /**
             * 微电网能量优化调度
             */
            public void optimizeEnergyDispatch() {
                // 获取当前系统状态
                MicrogridStatus status = getCurrentStatus();
                
                // 负荷预测
                LoadForecast forecast = forecastService.predictLoad(24); // 24小时预测
                
                // 储能系统状态评估
                BatteryStatus batteryStatus = bmsService.getBatteryStatus();
                
                // 优化调度策略
                DispatchStrategy strategy = calculateOptimalStrategy(status, forecast, batteryStatus);
                
                // 执行调度命令
                executeDispatchCommands(strategy);
            }
            
            private DispatchStrategy calculateOptimalStrategy(MicrogridStatus status, 
                                                            LoadForecast forecast, 
                                                            BatteryStatus batteryStatus) {
                DispatchStrategy strategy = new DispatchStrategy();
                
                // 经济性优化
                if (isLowTariffPeriod()) {
                    // 低电价时段，储能充电
                    strategy.setBatteryMode(BatteryMode.CHARGING);
                    strategy.setChargingPower(calculateOptimalChargingPower(batteryStatus));
                } else if (isPeakTariffPeriod()) {
                    // 高电价时段，储能放电
                    strategy.setBatteryMode(BatteryMode.DISCHARGING);
                    strategy.setDischargingPower(calculateOptimalDischargingPower(batteryStatus, forecast));
                }
                
                // 安全性约束
                applySafetyConstraints(strategy, batteryStatus);
                
                return strategy;
            }
        }

        // 锂离子电池技术特点
        @Component
        public class LithiumBatteryTechnology {
            
            /**
             * 电池健康状态评估
             */
            public BatteryHealthAssessment assessBatteryHealth(String batteryId) {
                BatteryData data = getBatteryData(batteryId);
                
                BatteryHealthAssessment assessment = new BatteryHealthAssessment();
                
                // SOH (State of Health) 计算
                double soh = calculateSOH(data);
                assessment.setSOH(soh);
                
                // 容量衰减分析
                double capacityFading = analyzeCapacityFading(data);
                assessment.setCapacityFading(capacityFading);
                
                // 内阻增长分析
                double resistanceIncrease = analyzeResistanceIncrease(data);
                assessment.setResistanceIncrease(resistanceIncrease);
                
                // 温度影响评估
                double temperatureImpact = assessTemperatureImpact(data);
                assessment.setTemperatureImpact(temperatureImpact);
                
                // 循环寿命预测
                int remainingCycles = predictRemainingCycles(data);
                assessment.setRemainingCycles(remainingCycles);
                
                return assessment;
            }
            
            /**
             * 电池均衡控制
             */
            public void performBatteryBalancing(String batteryPackId) {
                List cells = getCellData(batteryPackId);
                
                // 找出电压最高和最低的电池单体
                CellData maxVoltageCell = cells.stream()
                    .max(Comparator.comparing(CellData::getVoltage))
                    .orElse(null);
                    
                CellData minVoltageCell = cells.stream()
                    .min(Comparator.comparing(CellData::getVoltage))
                    .orElse(null);
                
                if (maxVoltageCell != null && minVoltageCell != null) {
                    double voltageDiff = maxVoltageCell.getVoltage() - minVoltageCell.getVoltage();
                    
                    // 如果电压差超过阈值，启动均衡
                    if (voltageDiff > 0.05) { // 50mV阈值
                        startBalancing(maxVoltageCell.getCellId());
                    }
                }
            }
            
            /**
             * 热管理系统
             */
            public void manageThermalSystem(String batteryPackId) {
                ThermalData thermalData = getThermalData(batteryPackId);
                
                double avgTemperature = thermalData.getAverageTemperature();
                double maxTemperature = thermalData.getMaxTemperature();
                double minTemperature = thermalData.getMinTemperature();
                
                // 温度过高处理
                if (maxTemperature > 45.0) {
                    // 启动冷却系统
                    activateCoolingSystem(batteryPackId);
                    
                    // 降低充放电功率
                    reducePowerOutput(batteryPackId, 0.8);
                }
                
                // 温度过低处理
                if (minTemperature < 0.0) {
                    // 启动加热系统
                    activateHeatingSystem(batteryPackId);
                    
                    // 限制充电功率
                    limitChargingPower(batteryPackId, 0.5);
                }
                
                // 温差过大处理
                if ((maxTemperature - minTemperature) > 10.0) {
                    // 优化热管理策略
                    optimizeThermalManagement(batteryPackId);
                }
            }
        }

        @Component

            /**
             * 上位机主控制器
             */
            @PostConstruct
            public void initializeSystem() {
