                serialService.initializeSerialPorts();
                
                // 启动数据采集线程
                startDataCollectionThread();
                
                // 初始化用户界面
                initializeUserInterface();
            }
            
            /**
             * 实时数据监控
             */
            @Scheduled(fixedRate = 1000) // 每秒执行一次
            public void monitorRealTimeData() {
                List deviceDataList = collectDeviceData();
                
                for (DeviceData data : deviceDataList) {
                    // 数据验证
                    if (validateData(data)) {
                        // 存储到数据库
                        databaseService.saveDeviceData(data);
                        
                        // 实时显示更新
                        updateRealTimeDisplay(data);
                        
                        // 告警检测
                        checkAlarmConditions(data);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 数据库开发
        -- SQLServer数据库设计
        
        -- 设备信息表
        CREATE TABLE DeviceInfo (
            DeviceID NVARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
            DeviceName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
            DeviceType NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            Location NVARCHAR(200),
            InstallDate DATETIME,
            Status NVARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Online',
            CreateTime DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
        );
        
        -- 实时数据表
        CREATE TABLE RealTimeData (
            ID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
            DeviceID NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            Voltage DECIMAL(10,3),
            Current DECIMAL(10,3),
            Power DECIMAL(10,3),
            Temperature DECIMAL(5,2),
            SOC DECIMAL(5,2),
            SOH DECIMAL(5,2),
            Timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
            FOREIGN KEY (DeviceID) REFERENCES DeviceInfo(DeviceID)
        );
        
        -- 历史数据表（按月分区）
        CREATE TABLE HistoricalData (
            ID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
            DeviceID NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            DataType NVARCHAR(50),
            DataValue DECIMAL(15,6),
            Unit NVARCHAR(20),
            Quality TINYINT DEFAULT 1, -- 数据质量标识
            Timestamp DATETIME,
            PartitionKey AS (YEAR(Timestamp) * 100 + MONTH(Timestamp)) PERSISTED
        ) ON ps_HistoricalData(PartitionKey);
        
        -- 告警记录表
        CREATE TABLE AlarmRecords (
            AlarmID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
            DeviceID NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            AlarmType NVARCHAR(50),
            AlarmLevel NVARCHAR(20), -- INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
            AlarmMessage NVARCHAR(500),
            AlarmTime DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
            AckTime DATETIME,
            AckUser NVARCHAR(50),
            Status NVARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Active' -- Active, Acknowledged, Cleared
        );
        
        -- 存储过程：数据清理
        CREATE PROCEDURE sp_CleanHistoricalData
            @RetentionDays INT = 365
        AS
        BEGIN
            SET NOCOUNT ON;
            
            DECLARE @CutoffDate DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, -@RetentionDays, GETDATE());
            
            -- 删除过期历史数据
            DELETE FROM HistoricalData 
            WHERE Timestamp < @CutoffDate;
            
            -- 删除已确认的告警记录（保留30天）
            DELETE FROM AlarmRecords 
            WHERE Status = 'Cleared' 
            AND AlarmTime < DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE());
            
            -- 重建索引
            ALTER INDEX ALL ON HistoricalData REBUILD;
        END;

        // 案例1：某工业园区储能项目
        项目规模：5MW/10MWh
        技术特点：
        - 峰谷套利：利用电价差进行充放电

        关键技术实现：
        @Service
        public class IndustrialParkEMS {
            
            /**
             * 峰谷套利策略
             */
            public void peakValleyArbitrage() {
                ElectricityPrice currentPrice = getCurrentElectricityPrice();
                BatteryStatus batteryStatus = getBatteryStatus();
                LoadForecast loadForecast = getLoadForecast();
                
                if (currentPrice.isValleyPeriod() && batteryStatus.getSOC() < 90) {
                    // 谷期充电
                    setChargingPower(calculateOptimalChargingPower());
                } else if (currentPrice.isPeakPeriod() && batteryStatus.getSOC() > 20) {
                    // 峰期放电
                    setDischargingPower(calculateOptimalDischargingPower());
                }
            }
            
            /**
             * 需量管理
             */
            public void demandManagement() {
                double currentDemand = getCurrentDemand();
                double targetDemand = getTargetDemand();
                
                if (currentDemand > targetDemand) {
                    // 启动储能放电，降低需量
                    double requiredPower = currentDemand - targetDemand;
                    setDischargingPower(Math.min(requiredPower, getMaxDischargingPower()));
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 案例2：某电网侧储能调频项目
        项目规模：20MW/10MWh
        技术特点：
        - 一次调频：快速响应频率变化
        - 二次调频：接受AGC指令调节
        - 惯量支撑：提供虚拟惯量
        
        关键技术实现：
        @Component
        public class GridSideFrequencyRegulation {
            
            /**
             * 一次调频控制
             */
            public void primaryFrequencyControl() {
                double systemFrequency = getSystemFrequency();
                double nominalFrequency = 50.0; // 额定频率50Hz
                double deadband = 0.05; // 死区±0.05Hz
                
                double frequencyDeviation = systemFrequency - nominalFrequency;
                
                if (Math.abs(frequencyDeviation) > deadband) {
                    // 计算调节功率
                    double regulationPower = -frequencyDeviation * getDroopCoefficient();
                    
                    // 限制在额定功率范围内
                    regulationPower = Math.max(-20000, Math.min(20000, regulationPower));
                    
                    // 执行功率调节
                    setPowerOutput(regulationPower);
                }
            }
            
            /**
             * AGC二次调频
             */
            public void secondaryFrequencyControl(double agcSignal) {
                // AGC信号范围：-1到1
                double targetPower = agcSignal * getRatedPower();
                
                // 考虑SOC约束
                BatteryStatus status = getBatteryStatus();
                if (targetPower > 0 && status.getSOC() < 20) {
                    // SOC过低，限制放电
                    targetPower = 0;
                } else if (targetPower < 0 && status.getSOC() > 90) {
                    // SOC过高，限制充电
                    targetPower = 0;
                }
                
                setPowerOutput(targetPower);
            }
        }

// 1. Java核心技术栈
        Java 8+特性应用
        - Lambda表达式：简化集合操作和函数式编程
        - Stream API：高效处理充电数据流
        - CompletableFuture：异步处理充电请求
        - Optional：避免空指针异常
        - 新时间API：处理充电时间计算
        
        @RestController
        @RequestMapping("/api/charging")
        public class ChargingController {
            
            @Autowired
            private ChargingService chargingService;
            
            /**
             * 启动充电 - 使用CompletableFuture异步处理
             */
            @PostMapping("/start")
            public CompletableFuture> startCharging(
                    @RequestBody ChargingRequest request) {
                
                return chargingService.startChargingAsync(request)
                    .thenApply(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(result))
                    .exceptionally(ex -> {
                        log.error("充电启动失败", ex);
                        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                            .body(ChargingResponse.error(ex.getMessage()));
                    });
            }
            
            /**
             * 批量查询充电桩状态 - 使用Stream API
             */
            @GetMapping("/status/batch")
            public ResponseEntity> getBatchStatus(
                    @RequestParam List pileIds) {
                
                List statusList = pileIds.stream()
                    .parallel() // 并行处理提高性能
                    .map(chargingService::getPileStatus)
                    .filter(Optional::isPresent)
                    .map(Optional::get)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
                    
                return ResponseEntity.ok(statusList);
            }
        }

物联网通信协议实现 ▶ 
// 1. OCPP协议实现
        @Component
        public class OCPPProtocolHandler {
            
            private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(OCPPProtocolHandler.class);
            
            @Autowired
            private ChargingPileService pileService;
            
            /**
             * OCPP 1.6 BootNotification处理
             */
            public BootNotificationResponse handleBootNotification(String pileId, 
                                                                  BootNotificationRequest request) {
                log.info("收到充电桩{}的BootNotification: {}", pileId, request);
                
                // 验证充电桩信息
                ChargingPile pile = pileService.getPileById(pileId);
                if (pile == null) {
                    return BootNotificationResponse.rejected("充电桩未注册");
                }
                
                // 更新充电桩状态
                pile.setStatus(PileStatus.AVAILABLE);
                pile.setLastHeartbeat(Instant.now());
                pileService.updatePile(pile);
                
                return BootNotificationResponse.accepted(300); // 300秒心跳间隔
            }
            
            /**
             * OCPP 2.0 StatusNotification处理
             */
            public StatusNotificationResponse handleStatusNotification(String pileId,
                                                                      StatusNotificationRequest request) {
                log.info("充电桩{}状态变更: {} -> {}", pileId, 
                        request.getConnectorId(), request.getConnectorStatus());
                
                // 更新连接器状态
                pileService.updateConnectorStatus(pileId, 
                                                 request.getConnectorId(), 
                                                 request.getConnectorStatus());
                
                // 如果是故障状态，触发告警
                if (request.getConnectorStatus() == ConnectorStatus.FAULTED) {
                    alarmService.triggerAlarm(pileId, "连接器故障", request.getErrorCode());
                }
                
                return new StatusNotificationResponse();
            }
            
            /**
             * StartTransaction处理
             */
            public StartTransactionResponse handleStartTransaction(String pileId,
                                                                 StartTransactionRequest request) {
                try {
                    // 验证RFID卡
                    if (!authService.validateIdTag(request.getIdTag())) {
                        return StartTransactionResponse.rejected("无效的RFID卡");
                    }
                    
                    // 创建充电事务
                    ChargingTransaction transaction = new ChargingTransaction();
                    transaction.setPileId(pileId);
                    transaction.setConnectorId(request.getConnectorId());
                    transaction.setIdTag(request.getIdTag());
                    transaction.setStartTime(Instant.now());
                    transaction.setMeterStart(request.getMeterStart());
                    
                    int transactionId = transactionService.createTransaction(transaction);
                    
                    return StartTransactionResponse.accepted(transactionId);
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("启动充电事务失败", e);
                    return StartTransactionResponse.rejected("系统错误");
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. GB/T 27930协议实现
        @Service
        public class GBTProtocolService {
            
            /**
             * GB/T 27930充电握手协议
             */
            public void handleChargingHandshake(String pileId, byte[] data) {
                // 解析握手报文
                GBTHandshakeMessage message = parseHandshakeMessage(data);
                
                if (message.getMessageType() == GBTMessageType.CHM) {
                    // 充电握手报文
                    handleCHMMessage(pileId, message);
                } else if (message.getMessageType() == GBTMessageType.CRM) {
                    // 充电机辨识报文
                    handleCRMMessage(pileId, message);
                }
            }
            
            private void handleCHMMessage(String pileId, GBTHandshakeMessage message) {
                // 验证BMS版本兼容性
                if (!isVersionCompatible(message.getBMSVersion())) {
                    sendErrorResponse(pileId, GBTErrorCode.VERSION_MISMATCH);
                    return;
                }
                
                // 发送充电机辨识报文
                GBTHandshakeMessage response = new GBTHandshakeMessage();
                response.setMessageType(GBTMessageType.CRM);
                response.setChargerVersion("1.0");
                response.setMaxVoltage(750); // 最大输出电压
                response.setMaxCurrent(250); // 最大输出电流
                
                sendMessage(pileId, response);
            }
        }

        // 3. MQTT通信实现
        @Component
        public class MQTTChargingClient {
            
            @Autowired
            private MqttTemplate mqttTemplate;
            
            /**
             * 发布充电桩状态
             */
            public void publishPileStatus(String pileId, PileStatus status) {
                String topic = String.format("charging/pile/%s/status", pileId);
                
                PileStatusMessage message = new PileStatusMessage();
                message.setPileId(pileId);
                message.setStatus(status);
                message.setTimestamp(Instant.now());
                
                mqttTemplate.convertAndSend(topic, message);
            }
            
            /**
             * 订阅充电控制指令
             */
            @MqttMessageListener(topics = "charging/pile/+/control")
            public void handleControlCommand(String topic, ChargingControlMessage message) {
                String pileId = extractPileIdFromTopic(topic);
                
                switch (message.getCommand()) {
                    case START_CHARGING:
                        chargingService.startCharging(pileId, message.getParameters());
                        break;
                    case STOP_CHARGING:
                        chargingService.stopCharging(pileId);
                        break;
                    case SET_POWER:
                        chargingService.setPower(pileId, message.getPower());
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Modbus通信实现
        @Service
        public class ModbusElectricMeterService {
            
            private ModbusMaster modbusMaster;
            
            @PostConstruct
            public void initModbus() {
                // 初始化Modbus连接
                IpParameters params = new IpParameters();
                params.setHost("192.168.1.100");
                params.setPort(502);
                
                modbusMaster = new ModbusMasterImpl(params);
            }
            
            /**
             * 读取电表数据
             */
            public ElectricMeterData readMeterData(int slaveId) {
                try {
                    // 读取电压、电流、功率等数据
                    int[] voltageRegisters = readHoldingRegisters(slaveId, 0x0000, 3);
                    int[] currentRegisters = readHoldingRegisters(slaveId, 0x0008, 3);
                    int[] powerRegisters = readHoldingRegisters(slaveId, 0x0010, 3);
                    int[] energyRegisters = readHoldingRegisters(slaveId, 0x0100, 2);
                    
                    ElectricMeterData data = new ElectricMeterData();
                    data.setVoltageA(voltageRegisters[0] / 10.0); // A相电压
                    data.setVoltageB(voltageRegisters[1] / 10.0); // B相电压
                    data.setVoltageC(voltageRegisters[2] / 10.0); // C相电压
                    data.setCurrentA(currentRegisters[0] / 100.0); // A相电流
                    data.setCurrentB(currentRegisters[1] / 100.0); // B相电流
                    data.setCurrentC(currentRegisters[2] / 100.0); // C相电流
                    data.setActivePower(powerRegisters[0]); // 有功功率
                    data.setReactivePower(powerRegisters[1]); // 无功功率
                    data.setTotalEnergy(combineRegisters(energyRegisters[0], energyRegisters[1]) / 100.0);
                    
                    return data;
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("读取电表数据失败", e);
                    throw new RuntimeException("电表通信异常", e);
                }
            }
        }

// 1. WebSocket服务器实现
        @Configuration
        @EnableWebSocket
        public class WebSocketConfig implements WebSocketConfigurer {
            
            @Override
            public void registerWebSocketHandlers(WebSocketHandlerRegistry registry) {
                registry.addHandler(new ChargingPileWebSocketHandler(), "/charging-pile/{pileId}")
                       .setAllowedOrigins("*")
                       .addInterceptors(new ChargingPileHandshakeInterceptor());
            }
        }
        
        @Component
        public class ChargingPileWebSocketHandler extends TextWebSocketHandler {
            
            private final Map pileSessionMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
            
            @Override
            public void afterConnectionEstablished(WebSocketSession session) throws Exception {
                String pileId = extractPileId(session);
                pileSessionMap.put(pileId, session);
                
                log.info("充电桩{}建立WebSocket连接", pileId);
                
                // 发送连接确认消息
                sendMessage(session, new ConnectionAckMessage(pileId));
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void handleTextMessage(WebSocketSession session, TextMessage message) 
                    throws Exception {
                String pileId = extractPileId(session);
                String payload = message.getPayload();
                
                // 解析OCPP消息
                OCPPMessage ocppMessage = parseOCPPMessage(payload);
                
                // 处理不同类型的消息
                switch (ocppMessage.getMessageType()) {
                    case CALL:
                        handleCallMessage(session, pileId, ocppMessage);
                        break;
                    case CALLRESULT:
                        handleCallResultMessage(session, pileId, ocppMessage);
                        break;
                    case CALLERROR:
                        handleCallErrorMessage(session, pileId, ocppMessage);
                        break;
                }
            }
            
            @Override
            public void handleTransportError(WebSocketSession session, Throwable exception) 
                    throws Exception {
                String pileId = extractPileId(session);
                log.error("充电桩{}WebSocket连接异常", pileId, exception);
                
                // 标记充电桩离线
                chargingPileService.markOffline(pileId);
            }
            
            @Override
            public void afterConnectionClosed(WebSocketSession session, CloseStatus status) 
                    throws Exception {
                String pileId = extractPileId(session);
                pileSessionMap.remove(pileId);
                
                log.info("充电桩{}断开WebSocket连接", pileId);
                
                // 标记充电桩离线
                chargingPileService.markOffline(pileId);
            }
            
            /**
             * 向指定充电桩发送消息
             */
            public void sendToPile(String pileId, Object message) {
                WebSocketSession session = pileSessionMap.get(pileId);
                if (session != null && session.isOpen()) {
                    try {
                        String jsonMessage = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(message);
                        session.sendMessage(new TextMessage(jsonMessage));
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        log.error("发送消息到充电桩{}失败", pileId, e);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Netty TCP服务器实现
        @Component
        public class NettyChargingPileServer {
            
            private EventLoopGroup bossGroup;
            private EventLoopGroup workerGroup;
            private Channel serverChannel;
            
            @PostConstruct
            public void start() {
                bossGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup(1);
                workerGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup();
                
                try {
                    ServerBootstrap bootstrap = new ServerBootstrap();
                    bootstrap.group(bossGroup, workerGroup)
                            .channel(NioServerSocketChannel.class)
                            .option(ChannelOption.SO_BACKLOG, 1024)
                            .childOption(ChannelOption.SO_KEEPALIVE, true)
                            .childOption(ChannelOption.TCP_NODELAY, true)
                            .childHandler(new ChargingPileChannelInitializer());
                    
                    ChannelFuture future = bootstrap.bind(8888).sync();
                    serverChannel = future.channel();
                    
                    log.info("Netty充电桩服务器启动成功，端口：8888");
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("Netty服务器启动失败", e);
                }
            }
            
            @PreDestroy
            public void stop() {
                if (serverChannel != null) {
                    serverChannel.close();
                }
                if (workerGroup != null) {
                    workerGroup.shutdownGracefully();
                }
                if (bossGroup != null) {
                    bossGroup.shutdownGracefully();
                }
            }
        }
        
        public class ChargingPileChannelInitializer extends ChannelInitializer {
            
            @Override
            protected void initChannel(SocketChannel ch) throws Exception {
                ChannelPipeline pipeline = ch.pipeline();
                
                // 添加编解码器
                pipeline.addLast("frameDecoder", new LengthFieldBasedFrameDecoder(65536, 0, 4, 0, 4));
                pipeline.addLast("frameEncoder", new LengthFieldPrepender(4));
                pipeline.addLast("stringDecoder", new StringDecoder(CharsetUtil.UTF_8));
                pipeline.addLast("stringEncoder", new StringEncoder(CharsetUtil.UTF_8));
                
                // 添加心跳检测
                pipeline.addLast("idleStateHandler", new IdleStateHandler(60, 30, 0));
                
                // 添加业务处理器
                pipeline.addLast("chargingPileHandler", new ChargingPileHandler());
            }
        }
        
        @ChannelHandler.Sharable
        public class ChargingPileHandler extends SimpleChannelInboundHandler {
            
            private final Map pileChannelMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
            
            @Override
            public void channelActive(ChannelHandlerContext ctx) throws Exception {
                log.info("充电桩连接建立：{}", ctx.channel().remoteAddress());
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void channelRead0(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, String msg) throws Exception {
                // 解析消息获取充电桩ID
                String pileId = extractPileIdFromMessage(msg);
                if (pileId != null) {
                    pileChannelMap.put(pileId, ctx.channel());
                }
                
                // 处理业务消息
                processChargingPileMessage(ctx, pileId, msg);
            }
            
            @Override
            public void userEventTriggered(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object evt) throws Exception {
                if (evt instanceof IdleStateEvent) {
                    IdleStateEvent event = (IdleStateEvent) evt;
                    if (event.state() == IdleState.READER_IDLE) {
                        log.warn("充电桩{}心跳超时，关闭连接", ctx.channel().remoteAddress());
                        ctx.close();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            @Override
            public void channelInactive(ChannelHandlerContext ctx) throws Exception {
                log.info("充电桩连接断开：{}", ctx.channel().remoteAddress());
                
                // 从映射中移除
                pileChannelMap.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue() == ctx.channel());
            }
        }

        -- 充电记录表设计（分表策略）
        CREATE TABLE charging_record_202401 (
            id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            pile_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '充电桩ID',
            user_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
            order_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '订单号',
            start_time DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '开始时间',
            end_time DATETIME COMMENT '结束时间',
            start_soc DECIMAL(5,2) COMMENT '开始SOC',
            end_soc DECIMAL(5,2) COMMENT '结束SOC',
            total_energy DECIMAL(10,3) COMMENT '总电量(kWh)',
            total_amount DECIMAL(10,2) COMMENT '总金额',
            status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态:1-充电中,2-已完成,3-异常结束',
            create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            
            INDEX idx_pile_id_time (pile_id, start_time),
            INDEX idx_user_id_time (user_id, start_time),
            INDEX idx_order_no (order_no),
            INDEX idx_status_time (status, start_time)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='充电记录表-2024年01月';
        
        -- 充电桩实时状态表
        CREATE TABLE pile_realtime_status (
            pile_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '充电桩ID',
            status TINYINT NOT NULL COMMENT '状态:0-离线,1-空闲,2-充电中,3-故障',
            voltage DECIMAL(6,2) COMMENT '电压(V)',
            current DECIMAL(6,2) COMMENT '电流(A)',
            power DECIMAL(8,2) COMMENT '功率(kW)',
            temperature DECIMAL(4,1) COMMENT '温度(℃)',
            connector_status JSON COMMENT '连接器状态',
            last_heartbeat DATETIME COMMENT '最后心跳时间',
            update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            
            INDEX idx_status (status),
            INDEX idx_last_heartbeat (last_heartbeat)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='充电桩实时状态表';

        CREATE PROCEDURE CreateMonthlyChargingTable(IN table_month VARCHAR(6))
        BEGIN
            SET @sql = CONCAT('CREATE TABLE charging_record_', table_month, ' LIKE charging_record_template');
            PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
            EXECUTE stmt;
            DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
        END //

        -- 查询优化示例
        @Repository
        public class ChargingRecordRepository {
            
            @Autowired
            private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
            
            /**
             * 分表查询充电记录
             */
            public List findByUserIdAndDateRange(String userId, 
                                                                LocalDate startDate, 
                                                                LocalDate endDate) {
                List tableNames = generateTableNames(startDate, endDate);
                List allRecords = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (String tableName : tableNames) {
                    String sql = String.format(
                        "SELECT * FROM %s WHERE user_id = ? AND start_time >= ? AND start_time < ? " +
                        "ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1000", tableName);
                    
                    List records = jdbcTemplate.query(sql, 
                        new Object[]{userId, startDate, endDate.plusDays(1)},
                        new ChargingRecordRowMapper());
                    
                    allRecords.addAll(records);
                }
                
                return allRecords.stream()
                    .sorted(Comparator.comparing(ChargingRecord::getStartTime).reversed())
                    .limit(1000)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }
        }

        // 2. Redis缓存设计
        @Service
        public class ChargingCacheService {
            
            @Autowired
            private RedisTemplate redisTemplate;
            
            private static final String PILE_STATUS_KEY = "pile:status:";
            private static final String USER_CHARGING_KEY = "user:charging:";
            private static final String PILE_QUEUE_KEY = "pile:queue:";
            
            /**
             * 缓存充电桩状态
             */
            public void cachePileStatus(String pileId, PileStatus status) {
                String key = PILE_STATUS_KEY + pileId;
                
                Map statusMap = new HashMap<>();
                statusMap.put("status", status.getCode());
                statusMap.put("voltage", status.getVoltage());
                statusMap.put("current", status.getCurrent());
                statusMap.put("power", status.getPower());
                statusMap.put("temperature", status.getTemperature());
                statusMap.put("updateTime", System.currentTimeMillis());
                
                redisTemplate.opsForHash().putAll(key, statusMap);
                redisTemplate.expire(key, Duration.ofMinutes(5));
            }
            
            /**
             * 获取充电桩状态
             */
            public PileStatus getPileStatus(String pileId) {
                String key = PILE_STATUS_KEY + pileId;
                Map statusMap = redisTemplate.opsForHash().entries(key);
                
                if (statusMap.isEmpty()) {
                    return null;
                }
                
                PileStatus status = new PileStatus();
                status.setPileId(pileId);
                status.setCode((Integer) statusMap.get("status"));
                status.setVoltage((Double) statusMap.get("voltage"));
                status.setCurrent((Double) statusMap.get("current"));
                status.setPower((Double) statusMap.get("power"));
                status.setTemperature((Double) statusMap.get("temperature"));
                
                return status;
            }
            
            /**
             * 用户充电会话缓存
             */
            public void cacheUserChargingSession(String userId, ChargingSession session) {
                String key = USER_CHARGING_KEY + userId;
                redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(key, session, Duration.ofHours(24));
            }
            
            /**
             * 充电桩排队管理
             */
            public void addToChargingQueue(String pileId, String userId) {
                String key = PILE_QUEUE_KEY + pileId;
                
                QueueItem item = new QueueItem(userId, System.currentTimeMillis());
                redisTemplate.opsForList().rightPush(key, item);
            }
            
            public String getNextInQueue(String pileId) {
                String key = PILE_QUEUE_KEY + pileId;
                QueueItem item = (QueueItem) redisTemplate.opsForList().leftPop(key);
                return item != null ? item.getUserId() : null;
            }
        }

        @Service
        public class ChargingMetricsService {
            
            @Autowired
            private InfluxDBClient influxDBClient;
            
            /**
             * 写入充电实时数据
             */
            public void writeChargingMetrics(String pileId, ChargingMetrics metrics) {
                Point point = Point.measurement("charging_metrics")
                    .addTag("pile_id", pileId)
                    .addTag("location", metrics.getLocation())
                    .addField("voltage", metrics.getVoltage())
                    .addField("current", metrics.getCurrent())
                    .addField("power", metrics.getPower())
                    .addField("energy", metrics.getEnergy())
                    .addField("temperature", metrics.getTemperature())
                    .addField("soc", metrics.getSoc())
                    .time(Instant.now(), WritePrecision.S);
                
                try (WriteApiBlocking writeApi = influxDBClient.getWriteApiBlocking()) {
                    writeApi.writePoint(point);
                }
            }
            
            /**
             * 查询充电功率趋势
             */
            public List queryPowerTrend(String pileId, 
                                                       Instant start, 
                                                       Instant end) {
                String flux = String.format(
                    "from(bucket: \"charging_bucket\")" +
                    "  |> range(start: %s, stop: %s)" +
                    "  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == \"charging_metrics\")" +
                    "  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pile_id == \"%s\")" +
                    "  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == \"power\")" +
                    "  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)",
                    start, end, pileId);
                
                List tables = influxDBClient.getQueryApi().query(flux);
                
                return tables.stream()
                    .flatMap(table -> table.getRecords().stream())
                    .map(record -> new PowerTrendData(
                        record.getTime(),
                        (Double) record.getValue()))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }
        }
充电桩业务流程实现 ▶ 
// 1. 即插即充业务流程
        @Service
        @Transactional
        public class PlugAndChargeService {
            
            @Autowired
            private VehicleAuthService vehicleAuthService;
            
            @Autowired
            private ChargingOrderService orderService;
            
            @Autowired
            private PaymentService paymentService;
            
            /**
             * 即插即充流程
             */
            public ChargingResult startPlugAndCharge(String pileId, String vehicleVin) {
                try {
                    // 1. 车辆身份验证
                    VehicleInfo vehicle = vehicleAuthService.authenticateVehicle(vehicleVin);
                    if (vehicle == null) {
                        return ChargingResult.failed("车辆未注册或认证失败");
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查充电桩状态
                    PileStatus pileStatus = pileService.getPileStatus(pileId);
                    if (pileStatus.getStatus() != PileStatusEnum.AVAILABLE) {
                        return ChargingResult.failed("充电桩不可用");
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 检查用户账户余额
                    UserAccount account = accountService.getUserAccount(vehicle.getUserId());
                    if (account.getBalance().compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(10)) < 0) {
                        return ChargingResult.failed("账户余额不足");
                    }
                    
                    // 4. 创建充电订单
                    ChargingOrder order = new ChargingOrder();
                    order.setPileId(pileId);
                    order.setUserId(vehicle.getUserId());
                    order.setVehicleVin(vehicleVin);
                    order.setOrderType(OrderType.PLUG_AND_CHARGE);
                    order.setStatus(OrderStatus.CHARGING);
                    order.setStartTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    
                    orderService.createOrder(order);
                    
                    // 5. 发送启动充电指令
                    ChargingCommand command = new ChargingCommand();
                    command.setPileId(pileId);
                    command.setAction(ChargingAction.START);
                    command.setOrderId(order.getId());
                    
                    boolean success = chargingControlService.sendCommand(command);
                    if (!success) {
                        orderService.updateOrderStatus(order.getId(), OrderStatus.FAILED);
                        return ChargingResult.failed("启动充电失败");
                    }
                    
                    // 6. 预授权扣款
                    paymentService.preAuthorize(vehicle.getUserId(), BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
                    
                    return ChargingResult.success(order.getId());
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("即插即充流程异常", e);
                    return ChargingResult.failed("系统异常：" + e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. 预约充电业务流程
        @Service
        public class ReservationChargingService {
            
            @Autowired
            private RedisTemplate redisTemplate;
            
            /**
             * 创建充电预约
             */
            public ReservationResult createReservation(ReservationRequest request) {
                // 1. 验证预约时间
                LocalDateTime reservationTime = request.getReservationTime();
                if (reservationTime.isBefore(LocalDateTime.now().plusMinutes(15))) {
                    return ReservationResult.failed("预约时间至少提前15分钟");
                }
                
                // 2. 检查充电桩可用性
                String lockKey = "pile:reservation:" + request.getPileId();
                Boolean lockAcquired = redisTemplate.opsForValue()
                    .setIfAbsent(lockKey, "locked", Duration.ofMinutes(30));
                
                if (!lockAcquired) {
                    return ReservationResult.failed("该时段已被预约");
                }
                
                try {
                    // 3. 创建预约记录
                    ChargingReservation reservation = new ChargingReservation();
                    reservation.setPileId(request.getPileId());
                    reservation.setUserId(request.getUserId());
                    reservation.setReservationTime(reservationTime);
                    reservation.setDuration(request.getDuration());
                    reservation.setStatus(ReservationStatus.ACTIVE);
                    
                    reservationRepository.save(reservation);
                    
                    // 4. 设置预约提醒
                    scheduleReservationReminder(reservation);
                    
                    return ReservationResult.success(reservation.getId());
                    
                } finally {
                    redisTemplate.delete(lockKey);
                }
            }
            
            /**
             * 预约到期自动处理
             */
            @Scheduled(fixedRate = 60000) // 每分钟检查一次
            public void processExpiredReservations() {
                LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
                List expiredReservations = 
                    reservationRepository.findExpiredReservations(now);
                
                for (ChargingReservation reservation : expiredReservations) {
                    if (reservation.getStatus() == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE) {
                        // 检查用户是否已到达
                        if (!checkUserArrival(reservation)) {
                            // 用户未到达，取消预约
                            reservation.setStatus(ReservationStatus.EXPIRED);
                            reservationRepository.save(reservation);
                            
                            // 释放充电桩
                            pileService.releasePile(reservation.getPileId());
                            
                            // 发送通知
                            notificationService.sendReservationExpiredNotification(reservation);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. 分时计价业务流程
        @Service
        public class TimeBasedPricingService {
            
            /**
             * 计算充电费用
             */
            public ChargingFee calculateChargingFee(ChargingRecord record) {
                LocalDateTime startTime = record.getStartTime();
                LocalDateTime endTime = record.getEndTime();
                BigDecimal totalEnergy = record.getTotalEnergy();
                
                // 获取分时电价配置
                List priceConfig = priceConfigService.getPriceConfig(record.getPileId());
                
                BigDecimal totalElectricityFee = BigDecimal.ZERO;
                BigDecimal totalServiceFee = BigDecimal.ZERO;
                
                // 按时间段计算费用
                LocalDateTime currentTime = startTime;
                BigDecimal remainingEnergy = totalEnergy;
                
                while (currentTime.isBefore(endTime) && remainingEnergy.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
                    // 找到当前时间段的电价
                    TimeBasedPrice currentPrice = findPriceForTime(priceConfig, currentTime);
                    
                    // 计算该时间段的结束时间
                    LocalDateTime segmentEndTime = getSegmentEndTime(currentTime, currentPrice, endTime);
                    
                    // 计算该时间段的充电时长（分钟）
                    long durationMinutes = Duration.between(currentTime, segmentEndTime).toMinutes();
                    
                    // 计算该时间段的用电量（假设匀速充电）
                    BigDecimal segmentEnergy = calculateSegmentEnergy(totalEnergy, startTime, endTime, 
                                                                    currentTime, segmentEndTime);
                    
                    // 计算电费
                    BigDecimal electricityFee = segmentEnergy.multiply(currentPrice.getElectricityPrice());
                    totalElectricityFee = totalElectricityFee.add(electricityFee);
                    
                    // 计算服务费
                    BigDecimal serviceFee = segmentEnergy.multiply(currentPrice.getServicePrice());
                    totalServiceFee = totalServiceFee.add(serviceFee);
                    
                    currentTime = segmentEndTime;
                    remainingEnergy = remainingEnergy.subtract(segmentEnergy);
                }
                
                ChargingFee fee = new ChargingFee();
                fee.setElectricityFee(totalElectricityFee);
                fee.setServiceFee(totalServiceFee);
                fee.setTotalFee(totalElectricityFee.add(totalServiceFee));
                
                return fee;
            }
            
            /**
             * 实时费用计算
             */
            public BigDecimal calculateRealTimeFee(String orderId) {
                ChargingOrder order = orderService.getOrder(orderId);
                if (order == null || order.getStatus() != OrderStatus.CHARGING) {
                    return BigDecimal.ZERO;
                }
                
                // 获取当前充电数据
                ChargingMetrics currentMetrics = metricsService.getCurrentMetrics(order.getPileId());
                
                // 模拟充电记录用于计算
                ChargingRecord simulatedRecord = new ChargingRecord();
                simulatedRecord.setPileId(order.getPileId());
                simulatedRecord.setStartTime(order.getStartTime());
                simulatedRecord.setEndTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                simulatedRecord.setTotalEnergy(currentMetrics.getTotalEnergy());
                
                ChargingFee fee = calculateChargingFee(simulatedRecord);
                return fee.getTotalFee();
            }
        }

        // 3. TLS加密与国密算法
        @Configuration
        public class SecurityConfig {
            
            /**
             * TLS配置
             */
            @Bean
            public TomcatServletWebServerFactory tomcatFactory() {
                TomcatServletWebServerFactory factory = new TomcatServletWebServerFactory();
                
                factory.addConnectorCustomizers(connector -> {
                    connector.setScheme("https");
                    connector.setSecure(true);
                    connector.setPort(8443);
                    
                    Http11NioProtocol protocol = (Http11NioProtocol) connector.getProtocolHandler();
                    protocol.setSSLEnabled(true);
                    protocol.setKeystoreFile("/path/to/keystore.jks");
                    protocol.setKeystorePass("password");
                    protocol.setKeyAlias("charging-pile");
                    protocol.setClientAuth("false");
                    protocol.setSSLProtocol("TLS");
                    protocol.setCiphers("TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384," +
                                       "TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256");
                });
                
                return factory;
            }
        }
        
        @Service
        public class SM2CryptoService {
            
            private static final String SM2_ALGORITHM = "SM2";
            private static final String SM4_ALGORITHM = "SM4/ECB/PKCS5Padding";
            
            /**
             * SM2数字签名
             */
            public String signWithSM2(String data, PrivateKey privateKey) throws Exception {
                Signature signature = Signature.getInstance("SM3withSM2", "BC");
                signature.initSign(privateKey);
                signature.update(data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

10.3 监控摄像头系统系统

如何设计一个类似萤石监控摄像头的APP系统？ ▶

系统架构设计：

1. 核心功能模块：

  • 用户管理：注册登录、权限管理、多租户支持
  • 设备管理：设备添加、配置、状态监控、远程控制
  • 实时监控：视频直播、多画面显示、云台控制
  • 录像回放：历史录像查询、时间轴播放、片段下载
  • 智能告警：移动侦测、人脸识别、异常行为分析
  • 云存储：录像云端存储、智能压缩、分级存储

2. 用户服务实现：

@RestController
            @RequestMapping("/api/user")
            public class UserController {

            @Autowired
            private UserService userService;

            @Autowired
            private JwtTokenUtil jwtTokenUtil;

            /**
            * 用户注册
            */
            @PostMapping("/register")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> register(@RequestBody UserRegisterRequest request) {
                try {
                    // 1. 参数验证
                    if (!isValidEmail(request.getEmail())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "邮箱格式不正确"));
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查用户是否已存在
                    if (userService.existsByEmail(request.getEmail())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "邮箱已被注册"));
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 创建用户
                    User user = new User();
                    user.setEmail(request.getEmail());
                    user.setPassword(encryptPassword(request.getPassword()));
                    user.setNickname(request.getNickname());
                    user.setPhone(request.getPhone());
                    user.setCreateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    user.setStatus(UserStatus.ACTIVE);
                    
                    User savedUser = userService.save(user);
                    
                    // 4. 生成JWT令牌
                    String token = jwtTokenUtil.generateToken(savedUser);
                    
                    UserResponse response = new UserResponse(savedUser, token);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "注册成功", response));
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "注册失败: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }

            /**
            * 用户登录
            */
            @PostMapping("/login")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> login(@RequestBody UserLoginRequest request) {
                try {
                    // 1. 验证用户凭据
                    User user = userService.findByEmail(request.getEmail());
                    if (user == null || !verifyPassword(request.getPassword(), user.getPassword())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "邮箱或密码错误"));
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查用户状态
                    if (user.getStatus() != UserStatus.ACTIVE) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "账户已被禁用"));
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 更新最后登录时间
                    user.setLastLoginTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    userService.update(user);
                    
                    // 4. 生成JWT令牌
                    String token = jwtTokenUtil.generateToken(user);
                    
                    UserResponse response = new UserResponse(user, token);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "登录成功", response));
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "登录失败: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }
            }

3. 设备管理服务：

@RestController
            @RequestMapping("/api/device")
            public class DeviceController {

            @Autowired
            private DeviceService deviceService;

            @Autowired
            private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;

            /**
            * 添加设备
            */
            @PostMapping("/add")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> addDevice(@RequestBody DeviceAddRequest request, 
                                                            @RequestHeader("Authorization") String token) {
                try {
                    // 1. 获取当前用户
                    Long userId = getUserIdFromToken(token);
                    
                    // 2. 验证设备序列号
                    if (deviceService.existsBySerialNumber(request.getSerialNumber())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "设备已被添加"));
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 验证设备验证码
                    if (!validateDeviceCode(request.getSerialNumber(), request.getVerifyCode())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "设备验证码错误"));
                    }
                    
                    // 4. 创建设备记录
                    Device device = new Device();
                    device.setUserId(userId);
                    device.setSerialNumber(request.getSerialNumber());
                    device.setDeviceName(request.getDeviceName());
                    device.setDeviceType(request.getDeviceType());
                    device.setLocation(request.getLocation());
                    device.setCreateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    device.setStatus(DeviceStatus.OFFLINE);
                    
                    // 5. 初始化设备配置
                    DeviceConfig config = new DeviceConfig();
                    config.setResolution("1920x1080");
                    config.setFrameRate(25);
                    config.setBitRate(2048);
                    config.setRecordMode(RecordMode.CONTINUOUS);
                    device.setConfig(config);
                    
                    Device savedDevice = deviceService.save(device);
                    
                    // 6. 缓存设备信息
                    redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(
                        "device:" + savedDevice.getId(), 
                        savedDevice, 
                        3600, TimeUnit.SECONDS
                    );
                    
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "设备添加成功", savedDevice));
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "添加设备失败: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }

            /**
            * 获取设备列表
            */
            @GetMapping("/list")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> getDeviceList(@RequestHeader("Authorization") String token,
                                                                @RequestParam("page") int page,
                                                                @RequestParam("size") int size) {
                try {
                    Long userId = getUserIdFromToken(token);
                    
                    // 分页查询用户设备
                    Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(page, size);
                    Page<Device> devicePage = deviceService.findByUserId(userId, pageable);
                    
                    // 获取设备实时状态
                    List<DeviceResponse> deviceResponses = devicePage.getContent().stream()
                        .map(device -> {
                            DeviceResponse response = new DeviceResponse(device);
                            
                            // 从Redis获取设备在线状态
                            String onlineKey = "device:online:" + device.getId();
                            Boolean isOnline = redisTemplate.hasKey(onlineKey);
                            response.setOnline(isOnline != null && isOnline);
                            
                            // 获取最新录像时间
                            LocalDateTime lastRecordTime = deviceService.getLastRecordTime(device.getId());
                            response.setLastRecordTime(lastRecordTime);
                            
                            return response;
                        }).collect(Collectors.toList());
                    
                    PageResponse<DeviceResponse> pageResponse = new PageResponse<>(
                        deviceResponses, 
                        devicePage.getTotalElements(), 
                        devicePage.getTotalPages()
                    );
                    
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "获取成功", pageResponse));
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "获取设备列表失败: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }
            }

@RestController
            @RequestMapping("/api/video")
            public class VideoStreamController {

            @Autowired
            private VideoStreamService videoStreamService;

            @Autowired
            private WebSocketTemplate webSocketTemplate;

            /**
            * 开始实时预览
            */
            @PostMapping("/live/start")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> startLiveStream(@RequestBody LiveStreamRequest request,
                                                                @RequestHeader("Authorization") String token) {
                try {
                    Long userId = getUserIdFromToken(token);
                    
                    // 1. 验证设备权限
                    if (!hasDevicePermission(userId, request.getDeviceId())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.status(403)
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "无设备访问权限"));
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查设备在线状态
                    if (!isDeviceOnline(request.getDeviceId())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "设备离线"));
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 创建流媒体会话
                    StreamSession session = videoStreamService.createSession(
                        request.getDeviceId(), 
                        userId, 
                        request.getStreamType()
                    );
                    
                    // 4. 启动RTMP推流
                    String rtmpUrl = startRtmpStream(request.getDeviceId(), session.getSessionId());
                    
                    // 5. 生成播放地址
                    StreamUrls streamUrls = new StreamUrls();
                    streamUrls.setRtmpUrl(rtmpUrl);
                    streamUrls.setHlsUrl(generateHlsUrl(session.getSessionId()));
                    streamUrls.setFlvUrl(generateFlvUrl(session.getSessionId()));
                    streamUrls.setWebRtcUrl(generateWebRtcUrl(session.getSessionId()));
                    
                    LiveStreamResponse response = new LiveStreamResponse();
                    response.setSessionId(session.getSessionId());
                    response.setStreamUrls(streamUrls);
                    response.setStartTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "直播开始", response));
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "启动直播失败: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }

            /**
            * 云台控制
            */
            @PostMapping("/ptz/control")
            public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse> controlPtz(@RequestBody PtzControlRequest request,
                                                            @RequestHeader("Authorization") String token) {
                try {
                    Long userId = getUserIdFromToken(token);
                    
                    // 验证权限
                    if (!hasDevicePermission(userId, request.getDeviceId())) {
                        return ResponseEntity.status(403)
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "无设备控制权限"));
                    }
                    
                    // 发送云台控制指令
                    PtzCommand command = new PtzCommand();
                    command.setDeviceId(request.getDeviceId());
                    command.setAction(request.getAction()); // UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, ZOOM_IN, ZOOM_OUT
                    command.setSpeed(request.getSpeed());
                    command.setDuration(request.getDuration());
                    
                    Boolean success = videoStreamService.sendPtzCommand(command);
                    
                    if (success) {
                        return ResponseEntity.ok(new ApiResponse(true, "云台控制成功"));
                    } else {
                        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                            .body(new ApiResponse(false, "云台控制失败"));
                    }
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return ResponseEntity.status(500)
                        .body(new ApiResponse(false, "云台控制异常: " + e.getMessage()));
                }
            }
            }

5. 智能告警服务：

@Service
            public class AlarmService {

            @Autowired
            private AlarmRepository alarmRepository;

            @Autowired
            private MessageService messageService;

            @Autowired
            private AiAnalysisService aiAnalysisService;

            /**
            * 处理移动侦测告警
            */
            @EventListener
            public void handleMotionDetection(MotionDetectionEvent event) {
                try {
                    // 1. 检查告警规则
                    AlarmRule rule = getAlarmRule(event.getDeviceId(), AlarmType.MOTION_DETECTION);
                    if (rule == null || !rule.isEnabled()) {
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查时间段限制
                    if (!isInAlarmTimeRange(rule)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // 3. 检查告警频率限制
                    if (isAlarmTooFrequent(event.getDeviceId(), AlarmType.MOTION_DETECTION)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // 4. AI智能分析
                    AiAnalysisResult analysisResult = aiAnalysisService.analyzeMotion(
                        event.getImageData(), 
                        event.getMotionArea()
                    );
                    
                    // 5. 根据AI分析结果决定是否告警
                    if (analysisResult.getConfidence() < rule.getMinConfidence()) {
                        return; // 置信度不够，忽略
                    }
                    
                    // 6. 创建告警记录
                    Alarm alarm = new Alarm();
                    alarm.setDeviceId(event.getDeviceId());
                    alarm.setUserId(event.getUserId());
                    alarm.setAlarmType(AlarmType.MOTION_DETECTION);
                    alarm.setAlarmTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                    alarm.setAlarmLevel(calculateAlarmLevel(analysisResult));
                    alarm.setDescription("检测到移动物体: " + analysisResult.getDescription());
                    alarm.setImageUrl(saveAlarmImage(event.getImageData()));
                    alarm.setVideoUrl(saveAlarmVideo(event.getDeviceId()));
                    alarm.setStatus(AlarmStatus.UNREAD);
                    
                    Alarm savedAlarm = alarmRepository.save(alarm);
                    
                    // 7. 发送告警通知
                    sendAlarmNotification(savedAlarm, rule);
                    
                    // 8. 更新告警频率记录
                    updateAlarmFrequency(event.getDeviceId(), AlarmType.MOTION_DETECTION);
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    logger.error("处理移动侦测告警失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
                }
            }

            /**
            * 人脸识别告警处理
            */
            @EventListener
            public void handleFaceRecognition(FaceRecognitionEvent event) {
                try {
                    // 1. 人脸识别分析
                    FaceAnalysisResult faceResult = aiAnalysisService.analyzeFace(event.getImageData());
                    
                    if (faceResult.getFaces().isEmpty()) {
                        return; // 未检测到人脸
                    }
                    
                    // 2. 检查是否为陌生人
                    for (FaceInfo face : faceResult.getFaces()) {
                        Person recognizedPerson = recognizeFace(face, event.getUserId());
                        
                        if (recognizedPerson == null) {
                            // 陌生人告警
                            createStrangerAlarm(event, face);
                        } else {
                            // 记录已知人员出现
                            recordPersonAppearance(event, recognizedPerson);
                        }
                    }
                    
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    logger.error("处理人脸识别告警失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
                }
            }

            /**
            * 发送告警通知
            */
            private void sendAlarmNotification(Alarm alarm, AlarmRule rule) {
                // 1. APP推送
                if (rule.isAppPushEnabled()) {
                    PushMessage pushMessage = new PushMessage();
                    pushMessage.setUserId(alarm.getUserId());
                    pushMessage.setTitle("安防告警");
                    pushMessage.setContent(alarm.getDescription());
                    pushMessage.setData(Map.of(
                        "alarmId", alarm.getId(),
                        "deviceId", alarm.getDeviceId(),
                        "imageUrl", alarm.getImageUrl()
                    ));
                    
                    messageService.sendPushMessage(pushMessage);
                }
                
                // 2. 短信通知
                if (rule.isSmsEnabled() && alarm.getAlarmLevel().ordinal() >= AlarmLevel.HIGH.ordinal()) {
                    String phoneNumber = getUserPhoneNumber(alarm.getUserId());
                    String smsContent = String.format(
                        "【萤石云】您的设备%s在%s检测到异常，请及时查看。",
                        getDeviceName(alarm.getDeviceId()),
                        alarm.getAlarmTime().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MM-dd HH:mm"))
                    );
                    
                    messageService.sendSms(phoneNumber, smsContent);
                }
                
                // 3. 邮件通知
                if (rule.isEmailEnabled()) {
                    String email = getUserEmail(alarm.getUserId());
                    String emailContent = buildEmailContent(alarm);
                    
                    messageService.sendEmail(email, "安防告警通知", emailContent);
                }
            }
            }

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/products")
public class ProductController {
    
    @Autowired
    private ProductService productService;
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate redisTemplate;
    
    /**
     * 获取产品列表（支持分页和缓存）
     */
    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity> getProducts(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String category) {
        
        String cacheKey = String.format("products:%d:%d:%s", page, size, category);
        
        // 先从Redis缓存获取
        PageResult cachedResult = (PageResult) redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(cacheKey);
        if (cachedResult != null) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(cachedResult);
        }
        
        // 从数据库查询
        PageResult result = productService.getProducts(page, size, category);
        
        // 缓存结果（5分钟过期）
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(cacheKey, result, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
        
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }
    
    /**
     * 创建产品
     */
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity createProduct(@RequestBody @Valid ProductCreateRequest request) {
        Product product = productService.createProduct(request);
        
        // 清除相关缓存
        clearProductCache();
        
        // 发送产品创建事件到Kafka
        productEventProducer.sendProductCreatedEvent(product);
        
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(product);
    }
}
