集成第三方区块链服务(如Udun钱包API)，实现充提币、链上交易监控等功能：

Udun钱包API集成 ▶ 
/**
                * Udun钱包API集成服务
                * 实现充提币、地址生成、交易监控等功能
                */
                @Service
                @Slf4j
                public class UdunWalletService {
                    
                    @Value("${udun.api.url}")
                    private String apiUrl;
                    
                    @Value("${udun.api.key}")
                    private String apiKey;
                    
                    @Value("${udun.api.secret}")
                    private String apiSecret;
                    
                    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
                    private final RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
                    
                    /**
                    * 生成充币地址
                    */
                    public WalletAddress generateDepositAddress(String userId, String coinType) {
                        try {
                            // 构建请求参数
                            Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>();
                            params.put("coin_type", coinType);
                            params.put("user_id", userId);
                            params.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
                            
                            // 生成签名
                            String signature = generateSignature(params);
                            params.put("signature", signature);
                            
                            // 发送请求
                            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
                            headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
                            headers.set("X-API-KEY", apiKey);
                            
                            HttpEntity<Map<String, Object>> request = new HttpEntity<>(params, headers);
                            
                            ResponseEntity<UdunResponse<WalletAddress>> response = restTemplate.exchange(
                                apiUrl + "/api/v1/address/generate",
                                HttpMethod.POST,
                                request,
                                new ParameterizedTypeReference<UdunResponse<WalletAddress>>() {}
                            );
                            
                            if (response.getBody().isSuccess()) {
                                WalletAddress address = response.getBody().getData();
                                
                                // 缓存地址信息
                                redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(
                                    "wallet:address:" + userId + ":" + coinType, 
                                    address, 
                                    Duration.ofDays(30)
                                );
                                
                                return address;
                            } else {
                                throw new WalletException("生成地址失败: " + response.getBody().getMessage());
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("生成充币地址失败: userId={}, coinType={}", userId, coinType, e);
                            throw new WalletException("生成充币地址失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 提币申请
                    */
                    public WithdrawResult submitWithdraw(WithdrawRequest withdrawRequest) {
                        try {
                            // 风控检查
                            riskControlCheck(withdrawRequest);
                            
                            // 构建请求参数
                            Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>();
                            params.put("coin_type", withdrawRequest.getCoinType());
                            params.put("to_address", withdrawRequest.getToAddress());
                            params.put("amount", withdrawRequest.getAmount().toPlainString());
                            params.put("user_id", withdrawRequest.getUserId());
                            params.put("order_id", withdrawRequest.getOrderId());
                            params.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
                            
                            // 双层加密
                            String encryptedData = doubleEncrypt(params);
                            
                            Map<String, Object> requestBody = new HashMap<>();
                            requestBody.put("data", encryptedData);
                            requestBody.put("signature", generateSignature(requestBody));
                            
                            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
                            headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
                            headers.set("X-API-KEY", apiKey);
                            
                            HttpEntity<Map<String, Object>> request = new HttpEntity<>(requestBody, headers);
                            
                            ResponseEntity<UdunResponse<WithdrawResult>> response = restTemplate.exchange(
                                apiUrl + "/api/v1/withdraw/submit",
                                HttpMethod.POST,
                                request,
                                new ParameterizedTypeReference<UdunResponse<WithdrawResult>>() {}
                            );
                            
                            if (response.getBody().isSuccess()) {
                                WithdrawResult result = response.getBody().getData();
                                
                                // 记录提币日志
                                logWithdrawOperation(withdrawRequest, result);
                                
                                return result;
                            } else {
                                throw new WalletException("提币申请失败: " + response.getBody().getMessage());
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("提币申请失败: {}", withdrawRequest, e);
                            throw new WalletException("提币申请失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 查询交易状态
                    */
                    public TransactionStatus queryTransactionStatus(String txHash, String coinType) {
                        try {
                            Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>();
                            params.put("tx_hash", txHash);
                            params.put("coin_type", coinType);
                            params.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
                            
                            String signature = generateSignature(params);
                            
                            String url = String.format("%s/api/v1/transaction/status?tx_hash=%s&coin_type=%s×tamp=%d&signature=%s",
                                apiUrl, txHash, coinType, params.get("timestamp"), signature);
                            
                            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
                            headers.set("X-API-KEY", apiKey);
                            
                            HttpEntity<?> request = new HttpEntity<>(headers);
                            
                            ResponseEntity<UdunResponse<TransactionStatus>> response = restTemplate.exchange(
                                url,
                                HttpMethod.GET,
                                request,
                                new ParameterizedTypeReference<UdunResponse<TransactionStatus>>() {}
                            );
                            
                            return response.getBody().getData();
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("查询交易状态失败: txHash={}, coinType={}", txHash, coinType, e);
                            throw new WalletException("查询交易状态失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 双层加密方案
                    */
                    private String doubleEncrypt(Map<String, Object> data) {
                        try {
                            // 第一层：AES加密
                            String jsonData = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(data);
                            String aesEncrypted = AESUtil.encrypt(jsonData, apiSecret);
                            
                            // 第二层：RSA加密
                            String rsaEncrypted = RSAUtil.encrypt(aesEncrypted, getPublicKey());
                            
                            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(rsaEncrypted.getBytes());
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            throw new SecurityException("数据加密失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 生成API签名
                    */
                    private String generateSignature(Map<String, Object> params) {
                        try {
                            // 参数排序
                            TreeMap<String, Object> sortedParams = new TreeMap<>(params);
                            
                            // 构建签名字符串
                            StringBuilder signStr = new StringBuilder();
                            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : sortedParams.entrySet()) {
                                if (!"signature".equals(entry.getKey())) {
                                    signStr.append(entry.getKey()).append("=").append(entry.getValue()).append("&");
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // 添加密钥
                            signStr.append("key=").append(apiSecret);
                            
                            // HMAC-SHA256签名
                            return HmacUtil.hmacSha256(signStr.toString(), apiSecret);
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            throw new SecurityException("生成签名失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                }

开发与维护多链(BTC/ETH/TRON等)节点交互模块：

多链节点交互服务 ▶ 
/**
                * 多链节点交互服务
                * 支持BTC/ETH/TRON等主流公链
                */
                @Service
                @Slf4j
                public class MultiChainNodeService {
                    
                    private final Map<String, BlockchainClient> chainClients = new HashMap<>();
                    
                    @PostConstruct
                    public void initChainClients() {
                        // 初始化各链客户端
                        chainClients.put("BTC", new BitcoinClient());
                        chainClients.put("ETH", new EthereumClient());
                        chainClients.put("TRON", new TronClient());
                        chainClients.put("BSC", new BscClient());
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取区块高度
                    */
                    public Long getBlockHeight(String chainType) {
                        BlockchainClient client = getChainClient(chainType);
                        return client.getLatestBlockNumber();
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取交易详情
                    */
                    public TransactionDetail getTransactionDetail(String chainType, String txHash) {
                        BlockchainClient client = getChainClient(chainType);
                        return client.getTransactionByHash(txHash);
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 监控地址交易
                    */
                    @Async("blockchainMonitorExecutor")
                    public void monitorAddressTransactions(String chainType, String address) {
                        BlockchainClient client = getChainClient(chainType);
                        
                        try {
                            // 获取最新区块
                            Long latestBlock = client.getLatestBlockNumber();
                            Long lastProcessedBlock = getLastProcessedBlock(chainType, address);
                            
                            // 扫描新区块
                            for (Long blockNumber = lastProcessedBlock + 1; blockNumber <= latestBlock; blockNumber++) {
                                Block block = client.getBlockByNumber(blockNumber);
                                
                                // 检查区块中的交易
                                for (Transaction tx : block.getTransactions()) {
                                    if (isAddressRelated(tx, address)) {
                                        processAddressTransaction(chainType, address, tx);
                                    }
                                }
                                
                                // 更新处理进度
                                updateLastProcessedBlock(chainType, address, blockNumber);
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("监控地址交易失败: chainType={}, address={}", chainType, address, e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 处理地址相关交易
                    */
                    private void processAddressTransaction(String chainType, String address, Transaction tx) {
                        try {
                            // 判断是充币还是提币
                            if (tx.getTo().equalsIgnoreCase(address)) {
                                // 充币交易
                                processDepositTransaction(chainType, address, tx);
                            } else if (tx.getFrom().equalsIgnoreCase(address)) {
                                // 提币交易
                                processWithdrawTransaction(chainType, address, tx);
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("处理地址交易失败: chainType={}, address={}, txHash={}", 
                                chainType, address, tx.getHash(), e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 处理充币交易
                    */
                    private void processDepositTransaction(String chainType, String address, Transaction tx) {
                        // 构建充币记录
                        DepositRecord deposit = DepositRecord.builder()
                            .chainType(chainType)
                            .txHash(tx.getHash())
                            .fromAddress(tx.getFrom())
                            .toAddress(tx.getTo())
                            .amount(tx.getValue())
                            .blockNumber(tx.getBlockNumber())
                            .confirmations(getConfirmations(chainType, tx.getBlockNumber()))
                            .status(getTransactionStatus(chainType, tx))
                            .timestamp(tx.getTimestamp())
                            .build();
                        
                        // 发送充币事件
                        eventPublisher.publishEvent(new DepositEvent(deposit));
                        
                        log.info("检测到充币交易: {}", deposit);
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取链客户端
                    */
                    private BlockchainClient getChainClient(String chainType) {
                        BlockchainClient client = chainClients.get(chainType.toUpperCase());
                        if (client == null) {
                            throw new UnsupportedChainException("不支持的链类型: " + chainType);
                        }
                        return client;
                    }
                }

3. 金融业务逻辑实现

实现永续合约、期权交易、秒合约等复杂金融产品的底层结算逻辑：

永续合约交易引擎 ▶ 
/**
                * 永续合约交易引擎
                * 支持杠杆交易、强制平仓、资金费率等功能
                */
                @Service
                @Slf4j
                public class PerpetualContractEngine {
                    
                    @Autowired
                    private PositionService positionService;
                    
                    @Autowired
                    private MarginService marginService;
                    
                    @Autowired
                    private FundingRateService fundingRateService;
                    
                    /**
                    * 开仓交易
                    */
                    @Transactional
                    public ContractTradeResult openPosition(ContractOrder order) {
                        try {
                            // 1. 风险检查
                            riskCheck(order);
                            
                            // 2. 计算保证金
                            BigDecimal requiredMargin = calculateRequiredMargin(order);
                            
                            // 3. 冻结保证金
                            marginService.freezeMargin(order.getUserId(), requiredMargin);
                            
                            // 4. 创建持仓
                            Position position = createPosition(order, requiredMargin);
                            
                            // 5. 执行撮合
                            MatchResult matchResult = executeMatching(order);
                            
                            // 6. 更新持仓
                            updatePosition(position, matchResult);
                            
                            // 7. 计算盈亏
                            calculatePnL(position);
                            
                            return ContractTradeResult.builder()
                                .success(true)
                                .position(position)
                                .matchResult(matchResult)
                                .build();
                                
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("开仓失败: {}", order, e);
                            throw new ContractTradeException("开仓失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 计算所需保证金
                    */
                    private BigDecimal calculateRequiredMargin(ContractOrder order) {
                        // 名义价值 = 数量 × 价格
                        BigDecimal notionalValue = order.getQuantity().multiply(order.getPrice());
                        
                        // 初始保证金率
                        BigDecimal initialMarginRate = getInitialMarginRate(order.getSymbol(), order.getLeverage());
                        
                        // 所需保证金 = 名义价值 × 初始保证金率
                        BigDecimal requiredMargin = notionalValue.multiply(initialMarginRate);
                        
                        // 加上手续费
                        BigDecimal tradingFee = calculateTradingFee(order);
                        
                        return requiredMargin.add(tradingFee);
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 强制平仓检查
                    */
                    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 5000) // 每5秒检查一次
                    public void liquidationCheck() {
                        try {
                            List<Position> positions = positionService.getAllActivePositions();
                            
                            for (Position position : positions) {
                                // 计算当前保证金率
                                BigDecimal currentMarginRatio = calculateMarginRatio(position);
                                
                                // 获取维持保证金率
                                BigDecimal maintenanceMarginRate = getMaintenanceMarginRate(position.getSymbol());
                                
                                // 如果保证金率低于维持保证金率，执行强制平仓
                                if (currentMarginRatio.compareTo(maintenanceMarginRate) < 0) {
                                    executeLiquidation(position);
                                }
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("强制平仓检查失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 执行强制平仓
                    */
                    private void executeLiquidation(Position position) {
                        try {
                            log.warn("执行强制平仓: positionId={}, userId={}", position.getId(), position.getUserId());
                            
                            // 创建强制平仓订单
                            ContractOrder liquidationOrder = ContractOrder.builder()
                                .userId(position.getUserId())
                                .symbol(position.getSymbol())
                                .side(position.getSide() == OrderSide.LONG ? OrderSide.SHORT : OrderSide.LONG)
                                .quantity(position.getQuantity())
                                .orderType(OrderType.MARKET)
                                .timeInForce(TimeInForce.IOC)
                                .isLiquidation(true)
                                .build();
                            
                            // 执行平仓
                            ContractTradeResult result = closePosition(liquidationOrder);
                            
                            // 记录强制平仓事件
                            recordLiquidationEvent(position, result);
                            
                            // 发送通知
                            notificationService.sendLiquidationNotification(position.getUserId(), position, result);
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("执行强制平仓失败: positionId={}", position.getId(), e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 计算资金费率
                    */
                    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 */8 * * ?") // 每8小时执行一次
                    public void calculateFundingRate() {
                        try {
                            List<String> symbols = contractConfigService.getAllContractSymbols();
                            
                            for (String symbol : symbols) {
                                // 获取标记价格和指数价格
                                BigDecimal markPrice = priceService.getMarkPrice(symbol);
                                BigDecimal indexPrice = priceService.getIndexPrice(symbol);
                                
                                // 计算溢价率
                                BigDecimal premiumRate = markPrice.subtract(indexPrice)
                                    .divide(indexPrice, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
                                
                                // 计算资金费率
                                BigDecimal fundingRate = calculateFundingRateFromPremium(premiumRate);
                                
                                // 保存资金费率
                                fundingRateService.saveFundingRate(symbol, fundingRate, System.currentTimeMillis());
                                
                                // 执行资金费用结算
                                settleFundingFee(symbol, fundingRate);
                                
                                log.info("资金费率计算完成: symbol={}, rate={}", symbol, fundingRate);
                            }
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("计算资金费率失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 结算资金费用
                    */
                    private void settleFundingFee(String symbol, BigDecimal fundingRate) {
                        List<Position> positions = positionService.getPositionsBySymbol(symbol);
                        
                        for (Position position : positions) {
                            // 计算资金费用
                            BigDecimal fundingFee = position.getNotionalValue().multiply(fundingRate);
                            
                            if (position.getSide() == OrderSide.LONG) {
                                // 多头支付资金费用
                                if (fundingRate.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
                                    marginService.deductMargin(position.getUserId(), fundingFee.abs());
                                } else {
                                    marginService.addMargin(position.getUserId(), fundingFee.abs());
                                }
                            } else {
                                // 空头收取资金费用
                                if (fundingRate.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
                                    marginService.addMargin(position.getUserId(), fundingFee.abs());
                                } else {
                                    marginService.deductMargin(position.getUserId(), fundingFee.abs());
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // 记录资金费用历史
                            recordFundingFeeHistory(position, fundingRate, fundingFee);
                        }
                    }
                }

/**
                * TradingView K线数据服务
                * 实现UDF协议，支持实时K线推送
                */
                @RestController
                @RequestMapping("/tradingview")
                @Slf4j
                public class TradingViewDataController {
                    
                    @Autowired
                    private KlineService klineService;
                    
                    @Autowired
                    private WebSocketService webSocketService;
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取配置信息
                    */
                    @GetMapping("/config")
                    public TradingViewConfig getConfig() {
                        return TradingViewConfig.builder()
                            .supportedResolutions(Arrays.asList("1", "5", "15", "30", "60", "240", "1D", "1W", "1M"))
                            .supportsMarks(false)
                            .supportsTimescaleMarks(false)
                            .supportsTime(true)
                            .timezone("Asia/Shanghai")
                            .build();
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取商品信息
                    */
                    @GetMapping("/symbols")
                    public SymbolInfo getSymbolInfo(@RequestParam String symbol) {
                        try {
                            ContractInfo contractInfo = contractService.getContractInfo(symbol);
                            
                            return SymbolInfo.builder()
                                .name(symbol)
                                .ticker(symbol)
                                .description(contractInfo.getDescription())
                                .type("crypto")
                                .session("24x7")
                                .timezone("Asia/Shanghai")
                                .minmov(1)
                                .pricescale(contractInfo.getPriceScale())
                                .hasIntraday(true)
                                .hasDaily(true)
                                .hasWeeklyAndMonthly(true)
                                .supportedResolutions(Arrays.asList("1", "5", "15", "30", "60", "240", "1D", "1W", "1M"))
                                .build();
                                
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("获取商品信息失败: symbol={}", symbol, e);
                            throw new TradingViewException("获取商品信息失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取历史K线数据
                    */
                    @GetMapping("/history")
                    public KlineHistoryResponse getHistory(
                            @RequestParam String symbol,
                            @RequestParam String resolution,
                            @RequestParam Long from,
                            @RequestParam Long to,
                            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "300") Integer countback) {
                        
                        try {
                            // 转换时间戳（TradingView使用秒，系统使用毫秒）
                            Long fromMs = from * 1000;
                            Long toMs = to * 1000;
                            
                            // 获取K线数据
                            List<Kline> klines = klineService.getKlineHistory(symbol, resolution, fromMs, toMs, countback);
                            
                            if (klines.isEmpty()) {
                                return KlineHistoryResponse.noData();
                            }
                            
                            // 转换数据格式
                            List<Long> timestamps = new ArrayList<>();
                            List<BigDecimal> opens = new ArrayList<>();
                            List<BigDecimal> highs = new ArrayList<>();
                            List<BigDecimal> lows = new ArrayList<>();
                            List<BigDecimal> closes = new ArrayList<>();
                            List<BigDecimal> volumes = new ArrayList<>();
                            
                            for (Kline kline : klines) {
                                timestamps.add(kline.getOpenTime() / 1000); // 转换为秒
                                opens.add(kline.getOpen());
                                highs.add(kline.getHigh());
                                lows.add(kline.getLow());
                                closes.add(kline.getClose());
                                volumes.add(kline.getVolume());
                            }
                            
                            return KlineHistoryResponse.builder()
                                .s("ok")
                                .t(timestamps)
                                .o(opens)
                                .h(highs)
                                .l(lows)
                                .c(closes)
                                .v(volumes)
                                .build();
                                
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("获取历史K线数据失败: symbol={}, resolution={}", symbol, resolution, e);
                            return KlineHistoryResponse.error("获取数据失败");
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * WebSocket实时K线推送
                    */
                    @EventListener
                    public void handleKlineUpdate(KlineUpdateEvent event) {
                        try {
                            Kline kline = event.getKline();
                            
                            // 构建TradingView格式的实时数据
                            TradingViewRealtimeData realtimeData = TradingViewRealtimeData.builder()
                                .symbol(kline.getSymbol())
                                .time(kline.getOpenTime() / 1000)
                                .open(kline.getOpen())
                                .high(kline.getHigh())
                                .low(kline.getLow())
                                .close(kline.getClose())
                                .volume(kline.getVolume())
                                .build();
                            
                            // 推送到WebSocket客户端
                            webSocketService.broadcastToTradingViewClients(realtimeData);
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("推送实时K线数据失败", e);
                        }
                    }
                }

                /**
                * WebSocket K线推送服务
                */
                @Component
                @Slf4j
                public class KlineWebSocketHandler extends TextWebSocketHandler {
                    
                    private final Set sessions = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
                    private final Map> symbolSubscriptions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
                    
                    @Override
                    public void afterConnectionEstablished(WebSocketSession session) throws Exception {
                        sessions.add(session);
                        log.info("TradingView WebSocket连接建立: sessionId={}", session.getId());
                    }
                    
                    @Override
                    public void afterConnectionClosed(WebSocketSession session, CloseStatus status) throws Exception {
                        sessions.remove(session);
                        
                        // 清理订阅
                        symbolSubscriptions.values().forEach(subs -> subs.remove(session));
                        
                        log.info("TradingView WebSocket连接关闭: sessionId={}, status={}", session.getId(), status);
                    }
                    
                    @Override
                    protected void handleTextMessage(WebSocketSession session, TextMessage message) throws Exception {
                        try {
                            String payload = message.getPayload();
                            JSONObject request = JSON.parseObject(payload);
                            
                            String action = request.getString("action");
                            String symbol = request.getString("symbol");
                            
                            switch (action) {
                                case "subscribe":
                                    subscribeSymbol(session, symbol);
                                    break;
                                case "unsubscribe":
                                    unsubscribeSymbol(session, symbol);
                                    break;
                                default:
                                    log.warn("未知的WebSocket操作: {}", action);
                            }
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("处理WebSocket消息失败: sessionId={}, message={}", session.getId(), message.getPayload(), e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 订阅交易对K线数据
                    */
                    private void subscribeSymbol(WebSocketSession session, String symbol) {
                        symbolSubscriptions.computeIfAbsent(symbol, k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet()).add(session);
                        log.info("订阅K线数据: sessionId={}, symbol={}", session.getId(), symbol);
                        
                        // 发送订阅确认
                        sendMessage(session, JSON.toJSONString(Map.of(
                            "type", "subscribe_success",
                            "symbol", symbol,
                            "timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis()
                        )));
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 取消订阅交易对K线数据
                    */
                    private void unsubscribeSymbol(WebSocketSession session, String symbol) {
                        Set subscribers = symbolSubscriptions.get(symbol);
                        if (subscribers != null) {
                            subscribers.remove(session);
                            if (subscribers.isEmpty()) {
                                symbolSubscriptions.remove(symbol);
                            }
                        }
                        log.info("取消订阅K线数据: sessionId={}, symbol={}", session.getId(), symbol);
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 推送K线数据到订阅的客户端
                    */
                    public void pushKlineData(String symbol, KlineData klineData) {
                        Set subscribers = symbolSubscriptions.get(symbol);
                        if (subscribers == null || subscribers.isEmpty()) {
                            return;
                        }
                        
                        String message = JSON.toJSONString(Map.of(
                            "type", "kline_update",
                            "symbol", symbol,
                            "data", klineData,
                            "timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis()
                        ));
                        
                        // 并发推送给所有订阅者
                        subscribers.parallelStream().forEach(session -> {
                            if (session.isOpen()) {
                                sendMessage(session, message);
                            } else {
                                // 清理已关闭的连接
                                subscribers.remove(session);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 发送消息到WebSocket客户端
                    */
                    private void sendMessage(WebSocketSession session, String message) {
                        try {
                            if (session.isOpen()) {
                                session.sendMessage(new TextMessage(message));
                            }
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("发送WebSocket消息失败: sessionId={}, message={}", session.getId(), message, e);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    /**
                    * 获取当前连接统计
                    */
                    public Map getConnectionStats() {
                        return Map.of(
                            "totalSessions", sessions.size(),
                            "symbolSubscriptions", symbolSubscriptions.size(),
                            "subscriptionDetails", symbolSubscriptions.entrySet().stream()
                                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                                    Map.Entry::getKey,
                                    entry -> entry.getValue().size()
                                ))
                        );
                    }
                }

企业级区块链技术栈

1. 区块链技术全景架构

基于企业级区块链应用开发需求，整合公链、联盟链、私有链技术栈和DApp开发的完整解决方案。

企业级区块链技术栈架构图

企业级区块链技术栈核心特性：

  • 多链生态支持：支持以太坊、Hyperledger Fabric、FISCO BCOS等主流区块链平台
  • 智能合约安全：完善的安全审计机制，包括重入攻击、溢出攻击等常见漏洞防护
  • 跨链互操作：实现不同区块链网络间的资产和数据互通
  • 企业级治理：支持多方治理、权限管控、合规审计等企业需求

2. DeFi智能合约开发实战

ERC20代币合约 - 企业级实现 ▶ 
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Pausable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Roles.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeMath.sol";

/**
 * 企业级ERC20代币合约
 * 具备完整的治理、安全防护和业务扩展功能
 */
contract EnterpriseToken is ERC20, ERC20Burnable, ERC20Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeMath for uint256;
    using Roles for Roles.Role;
    
    // 角色定义
    Roles.Role private _owners;
    Roles.Role private _minters;
    Roles.Role private _pausers;
    Roles.Role private _blacklisters;
    
    // 代币经济模型参数
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10**18; // 10亿代币
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 10000000000 * 10**18;    // 100亿代币上限
    uint256 public constant MINT_CAP_RATE = 200; // 每年最多增发2%
    
    // 业务状态变量
    mapping(address => bool) private _blacklisted;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _mintingAllowedAfter;
    
    uint256 public lastMintTime;
    uint256 public totalBurned;
    
    // 事件定义
    event Blacklisted(address indexed account);
    event UnBlacklisted(address indexed account);
    event MinterAdded(address indexed account);
    event MinterRemoved(address indexed account);
    event TokensBurned(address indexed burner, uint256 amount);
    
    // 修饰符
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owners.has(msg.sender), "EnterpriseToken: caller is not an owner");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlyMinter() {
        require(_minters.has(msg.sender), "EnterpriseToken: caller is not a minter");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlyPauser() {
        require(_pausers.has(msg.sender), "EnterpriseToken: caller is not a pauser");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier notBlacklisted(address account) {
        require(!_blacklisted[account], "EnterpriseToken: account is blacklisted");
        _;
    }
    
    constructor(string memory name, string memory symbol) ERC20(name, symbol) {
        // 初始化角色
        _owners.add(msg.sender);
        _minters.add(msg.sender);
        _pausers.add(msg.sender);
        _blacklisters.add(msg.sender);
        
        // 铸造初始供应量
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
        lastMintTime = block.timestamp;
    }
    
    /**
     * 受控铸币功能 - 符合代币经济模型
     */
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyMinter whenNotPaused {
        require(to != address(0), "EnterpriseToken: mint to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "EnterpriseToken: mint amount must be positive");
        
        // 检查供应量上限
        require(totalSupply().add(amount) <= MAX_SUPPLY, "EnterpriseToken: exceeds maximum supply");
        
        // 检查增发速率限制（防止恶意增发）
        uint256 timeSinceLastMint = block.timestamp.sub(lastMintTime);
        uint256 maxMintAmount = totalSupply().mul(MINT_CAP_RATE).div(10000)
            .mul(timeSinceLastMint).div(365 days);
        
        require(amount <= maxMintAmount, "EnterpriseToken: exceeds mint rate limit");
        
        _mint(to, amount);
        lastMintTime = block.timestamp;
    }
    
    /**
     * 增强的销毁功能
     */
    function burn(uint256 amount) public override {
        super.burn(amount);
        totalBurned = totalBurned.add(amount);
        emit TokensBurned(msg.sender, amount);
    }
    
    /**
     * 黑名单管理
     */
    function blacklist(address account) public onlyOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "EnterpriseToken: cannot blacklist zero address");
        require(!_blacklisted[account], "EnterpriseToken: account already blacklisted");
        
        _blacklisted[account] = true;
        emit Blacklisted(account);
    }
    
    function unBlacklist(address account) public onlyOwner {
        require(_blacklisted[account], "EnterpriseToken: account is not blacklisted");
        
        _blacklisted[account] = false;
        emit UnBlacklisted(account);
    }
    
    function isBlacklisted(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _blacklisted[account];
    }
    
    /**
     * 角色管理功能
     */
    function addMinter(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _minters.add(account);
        emit MinterAdded(account);
    }
    
    function removeMinter(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _minters.remove(account);
        emit MinterRemoved(account);
    }
    
    function isMinter(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _minters.has(account);
    }
    
    /**
     * 紧急暂停功能
     */
    function pause() public onlyPauser {
        _pause();
    }
    
    function unpause() public onlyPauser {
        _unpause();
    }
    
    /**
     * 重写转账函数，加入黑名单和暂停检查
     */
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) 
        public 
        override 
        whenNotPaused 
        notBlacklisted(msg.sender) 
        notBlacklisted(to) 
        returns (bool) 
    {
        return super.transfer(to, amount);
    }
    
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) 
        public 
        override 
        whenNotPaused 
        notBlacklisted(from) 
        notBlacklisted(to) 
        returns (bool) 
    {
        return super.transferFrom(from, to, amount);
    }
    
    /**
     * 批量转账功能 - 优化Gas使用
     */
    function batchTransfer(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) 
        external 
        whenNotPaused 
        notBlacklisted(msg.sender) 
        nonReentrant 
    {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "EnterpriseToken: arrays length mismatch");
        require(recipients.length <= 200, "EnterpriseToken: too many recipients");
        
        uint256 totalAmount = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amounts.length; i++) {
            totalAmount = totalAmount.add(amounts[i]);
        }
        
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= totalAmount, "EnterpriseToken: insufficient balance");
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            require(recipients[i] != address(0), "EnterpriseToken: transfer to zero address");
            require(!_blacklisted[recipients[i]], "EnterpriseToken: recipient is blacklisted");
            
            _transfer(msg.sender, recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 代币回购销毁机制
     */
    function buybackAndBurn(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "EnterpriseToken: amount must be positive");
        require(balanceOf(address(this)) >= amount, "EnterpriseToken: insufficient contract balance");
        
        _burn(address(this), amount);
        totalBurned = totalBurned.add(amount);
        emit TokensBurned(address(this), amount);
    }
    
    /**
     * 紧急提取功能（仅限紧急情况）
     */
    function emergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(token != address(this), "EnterpriseToken: cannot withdraw own tokens");
        
        if (token == address(0)) {
            // 提取ETH
            payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
        } else {
            // 提取ERC20代币
            IERC20(token).transfer(msg.sender, amount);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 查询函数
     */
    function getTokenInfo() external view returns (
        uint256 currentSupply,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        uint256 burnedAmount,
        uint256 lastMint,
        bool isPaused
    ) {
        return (
            totalSupply(),
            MAX_SUPPLY,
            totalBurned,
            lastMintTime,
            paused()
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * 兼容性函数重写
     */
    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) 
        internal 
        override(ERC20, ERC20Pausable) 
    {
        super._beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, amount);
    }
 }
区块链业务落地架构要点 ▶ 
🔧 技术架构设计原则

1. 多链支持策略
   • 公链选择：以太坊(通用DApp)、Polygon(低成本)、BSC(高性能)
   • 联盟链：Hyperledger Fabric(企业级)、FISCO BCOS(国产化)
   • 私有链：Quorum(隐私保护)、Hyperchain(定制化)

2. 智能合约安全防护
   • 重入攻击：使用ReentrancyGuard、CEI模式
   • 整数溢出：SafeMath库、Solidity 0.8+内置检查
   • 访问控制：基于角色的权限管理(RBAC)
   • 时间戳依赖：避免block.timestamp精确比较
   • 前置运行：commit-reveal机制、批量操作

3. 性能优化方案
   • Layer2扩容：Optimism、Arbitrum、Polygon
   • 状态通道：Lightning Network、Raiden
   • 侧链技术：自定义共识、定制化规则
   • 分片技术：以太坊2.0、Near Protocol

4. 跨链互操作
   • 原子交换：HTLC哈希时间锁
   • 跨链桥：资产锁定释放机制
   • 中继链：Polkadot、Cosmos Hub
   • 预言机：Chainlink跨链数据传输

1. 前端架构
   • Web3.js/Ethers.js：区块链交互
   • MetaMask集成：钱包连接管理  
   • IPFS集成：去中心化存储
   • React/Vue.js：现代化用户界面

2. 后端服务
   • 事件监听：智能合约事件订阅

   • 缓存策略：Redis缓存热点数据
   • API网关：统一接口管理

3. 安全审计流程
   • 静态分析：Slither、MythX自动化扫描
   • 形式化验证：Certora、Dafny数学证明
   • 人工审计：专业安全团队Review

/**
 * ADX广告交易平台核心架构
 * 支撑日均亿级广告请求的高并发场景
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/adx")
@Slf4j
public class AdExchangeController {
    
    @Autowired
    private RealTimeBiddingService rtbService;
    
    @Autowired
    private AdRequestProcessor requestProcessor;
    
    @Autowired
    private AntiFraudService antiFraudService;
    
    /**
     * 广告请求处理入口
     * 毫秒级响应，支持高并发
     */
    @PostMapping("/bid")
    public ResponseEntity<BidResponse> handleBidRequest(
            @RequestBody BidRequest bidRequest,
            HttpServletRequest request) {
        
        try {
            // 1. 请求验证与反作弊检测
            if (!antiFraudService.validateRequest(bidRequest, request)) {
                return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();
            }
            
            // 2. 流量质量检测
            TrafficQuality quality = antiFraudService.assessTrafficQuality(bidRequest);
            if (quality.getScore() < 0.7) {
                log.warn("低质量流量被拒绝: {}", bidRequest.getId());
                return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
            }
            
            // 3. 实时竞价处理
            BidResponse response = rtbService.processBidRequest(bidRequest);
            
            // 4. 记录竞价日志
            requestProcessor.logBidRequest(bidRequest, response);
            
            return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("处理竞价请求失败: {}", bidRequest.getId(), e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(500).build();
        }
    }
}
实时竞价(RTB)系统 ▶ 
/**
 * 毫秒级实时竞价系统
 * 优化DSP/SSP对接算法，提升广告填充率
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class RealTimeBiddingService {
    
    @Autowired
    private DspConnector dspConnector;
    
    @Autowired
    private SspConnector sspConnector;
    
    @Autowired
    private BiddingAlgorithm biddingAlgorithm;
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    /**
     * 处理竞价请求
     * 目标响应时间: <100ms
     */
    public BidResponse processBidRequest(BidRequest bidRequest) {
        StopWatch stopWatch = new StopWatch();
        stopWatch.start();
        
        try {
            // 1. 广告位匹配
            List<AdSlot> matchedSlots = findMatchingAdSlots(bidRequest);
            if (matchedSlots.isEmpty()) {
                return BidResponse.noBid();
            }
            
            // 2. 并行调用DSP进行竞价
            List<CompletableFuture<DspBidResponse>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (DspConfig dsp : getActiveDsps()) {
                CompletableFuture<DspBidResponse> future = CompletableFuture
                    .supplyAsync(() -> dspConnector.sendBidRequest(dsp, bidRequest))
                    .orTimeout(80, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); // 80ms超时
                futures.add(future);
            }
            
            // 3. 收集竞价结果
            List<DspBidResponse> bidResponses = futures.stream()
                .map(future -> {
                    try {
                        return future.get();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        log.warn("DSP竞价超时或失败", e);
                        return null;
                    }
                })
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            
            // 4. 竞价算法选择最优广告
            Optional<WinningBid> winningBid = biddingAlgorithm.selectWinner(bidResponses);
            
            if (winningBid.isPresent()) {
                // 5. 构建响应
                BidResponse response = buildBidResponse(winningBid.get(), bidRequest);
                
                // 6. 缓存竞价结果用于后续结算
                cacheBidResult(bidRequest.getId(), winningBid.get());
                
                return response;
            } else {
                return BidResponse.noBid();
            }
            
        } finally {
            stopWatch.stop();
            long duration = stopWatch.getTotalTimeMillis();
            
            // 监控响应时间
            if (duration > 100) {
                log.warn("RTB响应时间过长: {}ms, requestId={}", duration, bidRequest.getId());
            }
            
            // 记录性能指标
            recordMetrics(duration, bidRequest);
        }
    }
}
高性能广告投放引擎 ▶ 
/**
 * 高性能广告投放引擎
 * 实现精准流量匹配与智能出价策略
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class AdDeliveryEngine {
    
    @Autowired
    private AdTargetingService targetingService;
    
    @Autowired
    private FrequencyCapService frequencyCapService;
    
    @Autowired
    private BudgetPacingService budgetPacingService;
    
    @Autowired
    private CtrPredictionService ctrPredictionService;
    
    /**
     * 广告检索与匹配
     * 基于用户画像和上下文进行精准匹配
     */
    public List<AdCandidate> retrieveAds(AdRequest request) {
        // 1. 基础过滤
        List<AdCandidate> candidates = targetingService.findTargetedAds(request);
        
        // 2. 频次控制过滤
        candidates = candidates.stream()
            .filter(ad -> frequencyCapService.checkFrequencyCap(ad, request.getUserId()))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        // 3. 预算控制过滤
        candidates = candidates.stream()
            .filter(ad -> budgetPacingService.checkBudgetAvailable(ad))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        // 4. CTR预测与排序
        candidates.forEach(ad -> {
            double predictedCtr = ctrPredictionService.predict(ad, request);
            ad.setPredictedCtr(predictedCtr);
            ad.setEcpm(ad.getBidPrice() * predictedCtr * 1000);
        });
        
        // 5. 按eCPM排序
        return candidates.stream()
            .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(AdCandidate::getEcpm).reversed())
            .limit(10) // 返回Top 10
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    
    /**
     * 智能出价策略
     * 基于历史数据和实时反馈调整出价
     */
    public BigDecimal calculateOptimalBid(AdCandidate ad, AdRequest request) {
        // 1. 基础出价
        BigDecimal baseBid = ad.getBaseBidPrice();
        
        // 2. CTR调整因子
        double ctrFactor = ad.getPredictedCtr() / ad.getHistoricalCtr();
        
        // 3. 竞争激烈度调整
        double competitionFactor = calculateCompetitionFactor(request);
        
        // 4. 时段调整
        double timeFactor = getTimeBasedFactor();
        
        // 5. 预算消耗速度调整
        double pacingFactor = budgetPacingService.getPacingFactor(ad.getCampaignId());
        
        BigDecimal adjustedBid = baseBid
            .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(ctrFactor))
            .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(competitionFactor))
            .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(timeFactor))
            .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(pacingFactor));
        
        // 6. 出价边界控制
        BigDecimal maxBid = ad.getMaxBidPrice();
        BigDecimal minBid = ad.getMinBidPrice();
        
        if (adjustedBid.compareTo(maxBid) > 0) {
            adjustedBid = maxBid;
        } else if (adjustedBid.compareTo(minBid) < 0) {
            adjustedBid = minBid;
        }
        
        return adjustedBid;
    }
}
反作弊系统 ▶ 
/**
 * 反作弊系统与流量质量检测
 * 保障广告交易生态健康
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class AntiFraudService {
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private MachineLearningService mlService;
    
    /**
     * 请求验证
     * 检测异常请求模式
     */
    public boolean validateRequest(BidRequest bidRequest, HttpServletRequest httpRequest) {
        // 1. IP频率检测
        String clientIp = getClientIp(httpRequest);
        if (isIpBlocked(clientIp)) {
            log.warn("被阻止的IP请求: {}", clientIp);
            return false;
        }
        
        // 2. 请求频率限制
        if (exceedsRateLimit(clientIp)) {
            log.warn("IP请求频率过高: {}", clientIp);
            return false;
        }
        
        // 3. User-Agent检测
        String userAgent = httpRequest.getHeader("User-Agent");
        if (isSuspiciousUserAgent(userAgent)) {
            log.warn("可疑User-Agent: {}", userAgent);
            return false;
        }
        
        // 4. 设备指纹检测
        String deviceFingerprint = generateDeviceFingerprint(bidRequest);
        if (isDeviceBlacklisted(deviceFingerprint)) {
            log.warn("黑名单设备: {}", deviceFingerprint);
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * 流量质量评估
     * 使用机器学习模型评估流量质量
     */
    public TrafficQuality assessTrafficQuality(BidRequest bidRequest) {
        // 1. 提取特征
        Map<String, Object> features = extractFeatures(bidRequest);
        
        // 2. 机器学习模型预测
        double qualityScore = mlService.predictQuality(features);
        
        // 3. 规则引擎补充检测
        List<String> riskFactors = checkRiskFactors(bidRequest);
        
        // 4. 综合评分
        double finalScore = calculateFinalScore(qualityScore, riskFactors);
        
        return TrafficQuality.builder()
            .score(finalScore)
            .riskFactors(riskFactors)
            .mlScore(qualityScore)
            .timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis())
            .build();
    }
    
    /**
     * 特征提取
     */
    private Map<String, Object> extractFeatures(BidRequest bidRequest) {
        Map<String, Object> features = new HashMap<>();
        
        // 时间特征
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
        features.put("hour_of_day", now.getHour());
        features.put("day_of_week", now.getDayOfWeek().getValue());
        
        // 设备特征
        Device device = bidRequest.getDevice();
        if (device != null) {
            features.put("device_type", device.getDeviceType());
            features.put("os", device.getOs());
            features.put("browser", device.getBrowser());
            features.put("screen_resolution", device.getScreenResolution());
        }
        
        // 地理位置特征
        Geo geo = bidRequest.getGeo();
        if (geo != null) {
            features.put("country", geo.getCountry());
            features.put("city", geo.getCity());
            features.put("connection_type", geo.getConnectionType());
        }
        
        // 应用特征
        App app = bidRequest.getApp();
        if (app != null) {
            features.put("app_category", app.getCategory());
            features.put("app_bundle", app.getBundle());
        }
        
        return features;
    }
}

/**
 * 广告系统核心面试题与答案
 */

Q1: 如何设计一个支持日均亿级请求的ADX广告交易平台？

A1: 核心设计要点：
1. 架构设计：
   - 微服务架构，按业务域拆分（竞价、投放、结算、监控）
   - 无状态服务设计，支持水平扩展
   - 异步处理非核心流程，减少响应时间

2. 性能优化：
   - 多级缓存：本地缓存 + Redis集群
   - 连接池复用，减少连接开销
   - 批量处理，提高吞吐量
   - CDN加速静态资源

3. 数据存储：
   - 读写分离，主从复制
   - 分库分表，按时间或用户ID分片
   - 冷热数据分离，历史数据归档

4. 监控告警：
   - 实时监控QPS、响应时间、错误率
   - 链路追踪，快速定位问题
   - 自动扩缩容，应对流量波动

Q2: RTB实时竞价系统如何在100ms内完成竞价？

A2: 优化策略：
1. 并行处理：
   - 并行调用多个DSP，设置80ms超时
   - 使用CompletableFuture异步编程
   - 线程池隔离，避免相互影响

2. 预处理优化：
   - 广告索引预建，支持快速检索
   - 用户画像缓存，避免实时计算
   - 频次控制预计算

3. 算法优化：
   - 简化竞价算法，减少计算复杂度
   - 机器学习模型离线训练，在线预测
   - 规则引擎优化，提前过滤

4. 网络优化：
   - HTTP/2多路复用
   - 连接池复用
   - 数据压缩传输

Q3: 如何设计反作弊系统检测虚假流量？

A3: 多维度检测：
1. 实时检测：
   - IP频率限制，异常IP拉黑
   - 设备指纹识别，检测模拟器
   - User-Agent分析，识别爬虫
   - 行为模式分析，检测异常点击

2. 机器学习：
   - 特征工程：时间、地理、设备、行为特征
   - 异常检测模型：Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM
   - 实时评分，动态调整阈值

3. 规则引擎：
   - 黑白名单管理
   - 业务规则配置
   - 风险等级分类

4. 数据分析：
   - 离线分析历史数据
   - 模式挖掘，发现新的作弊手段
   - A/B测试验证效果

Q4: 广告投放系统如何实现精准定向？

A4: 多维度定向：
1. 用户画像：
   - 基础属性：年龄、性别、地域
   - 兴趣标签：基于行为数据挖掘
   - 消费能力：基于购买历史分析

2. 上下文定向：

Q5: 如何优化广告投放的eCPM？

A5: 优化策略：

2. 出价策略优化：

GIS服务架构设计 (Java + Spring Boot) ▶ 
// GIS核心服务控制器
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/gis")
@CrossOrigin(origins = "*")
public class GISController {
    
    @Autowired
    private SpatialDataService spatialDataService;
    
    @Autowired
    private GeoServerService geoServerService;
    
    // 空间查询接口
    @GetMapping("/spatial-query")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Feature>> spatialQuery(
            @RequestParam String geometry,
            @RequestParam String operation,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "4326") Integer srid) {
        
        try {
            List<Feature> results = spatialDataService.performSpatialQuery(
                geometry, operation, srid);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(results);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                .body(null);
        }
    }
    
    // 地图服务代理
    @GetMapping("/wms")
    public ResponseEntity<byte[]> getWMSMap(
            @RequestParam String layers,
            @RequestParam String bbox,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "256") Integer width,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "256") Integer height) {
        
        byte[] mapImage = geoServerService.getWMSMap(layers, bbox, width, height);
        
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.IMAGE_PNG);
        
        return new ResponseEntity<>(mapImage, headers, HttpStatus.OK);
    }
}
空间数据服务实现 ▶ 
// 空间数据处理服务
@Service
@Transactional
public class SpatialDataService {
    
    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    // 执行空间查询
    public List<Feature> performSpatialQuery(String geometry, 
                                                    String operation, 
                                                    Integer srid) {
        
        // 构建PostGIS空间查询SQL
        String sql = buildSpatialQuerySQL(geometry, operation, srid);
        
        // 检查缓存
        String cacheKey = "spatial_query:" + 
            DigestUtils.md5Hex(sql);
        
        List<Feature> cachedResult = 
            (List<Feature>) redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(cacheKey);
        
        if (cachedResult != null) {
            return cachedResult;
        }
        
        // 执行查询
        List<Feature> results = jdbcTemplate.query(sql, 
            new FeatureRowMapper());
        
        // 缓存结果
        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(cacheKey, results, 
            Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        
        return results;
    }
    
    // 构建空间查询SQL
    private String buildSpatialQuerySQL(String geometry, 
                                        String operation, 
                                        Integer srid) {
        
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder();
        sql.append("SELECT id, name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) as geometry ");
        sql.append("FROM spatial_features WHERE ");
        
        switch (operation.toLowerCase()) {
            case "intersects":
                sql.append("ST_Intersects(geom, ST_GeomFromText(?, ?))");
                break;
            case "contains":
                sql.append("ST_Contains(geom, ST_GeomFromText(?, ?))");
                break;
            case "within":
                sql.append("ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText(?, ?))");
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Unsupported spatial operation: " + operation);
        }
        
        return sql.toString();
    }
}
GeoServer集成服务 ▶ 
// GeoServer服务集成
@Service
public class GeoServerService {
    
    @Value("${geoserver.url}")
    private String geoServerUrl;
    
    @Value("${geoserver.username}")
    private String username;
    
    @Value("${geoserver.password}")
    private String password;
    
    @Autowired
    private RestTemplate restTemplate;
    
    // 获取WMS地图
    public byte[] getWMSMap(String layers, String bbox, 
                              Integer width, Integer height) {
        
        String wmsUrl = buildWMSUrl(layers, bbox, width, height);
        
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setBasicAuth(username, password);
        
        HttpEntity<String> entity = new HttpEntity<>(headers);
        
        ResponseEntity<byte[]> response = restTemplate.exchange(
            wmsUrl, HttpMethod.GET, entity, byte[].class);
        
        return response.getBody();
    }
    
    // 构建WMS请求URL
    private String buildWMSUrl(String layers, String bbox, 
                               Integer width, Integer height) {
        
        return UriComponentsBuilder.fromHttpUrl(geoServerUrl)
            .path("/wms")
            .queryParam("service", "WMS")
            .queryParam("version", "1.1.0")
            .queryParam("request", "GetMap")
            .queryParam("layers", layers)
            .queryParam("bbox", bbox)
            .queryParam("width", width)
            .queryParam("height", height)
            .queryParam("srs", "EPSG:4326")
            .queryParam("format", "image/png")
            .build()
            .toUriString();
    }
    
    // 发布图层到GeoServer
    public Boolean publishLayer(String workspace, 
                               String datastore, 
                               String layerName) {
        
        String restUrl = geoServerUrl + "/rest/workspaces/" + 
                         workspace + "/datastores/" + datastore + 
                         "/featuretypes";
        
        String layerXml = buildLayerXml(layerName);
        
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setBasicAuth(username, password);
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_XML);
        
        HttpEntity<String> entity = new HttpEntity<>(layerXml, headers);
        
        try {
            ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.exchange(
                restUrl, HttpMethod.POST, entity, String.class);
            
            return response.getStatusCode().is2xxSuccessful();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 构建图层XML配置
    private String buildLayerXml(String layerName) {
        return "<featureType>" +
               "<name>" + layerName + "</name>" +
               "<enabled>true</enabled>" +
               "</featureType>";
    }
}

🎯 核心面试问答

GIS技术面试精选 ▶ 
Q1: 如何优化PostGIS中大规模空间数据的查询性能？

A1: 多层次优化策略：
1. 空间索引优化：
   - 创建GiST索引：CREATE INDEX idx_geom ON table USING GIST(geom);
   - 使用SP-GiST索引处理点数据
   - 定期VACUUM和REINDEX维护索引

2. 查询优化：
   - 使用&&操作符进行边界框预筛选
   - 避免在WHERE子句中使用ST_Transform
   - 利用ST_DWithin替代ST_Distance + 比较

3. 数据分片策略：
   - 按地理区域进行表分区
   - 使用继承表实现水平分片
   - 实现分布式查询协调

4. 缓存机制：
   - Redis缓存热点查询结果
   - 瓦片缓存减少重复计算
   - 应用层结果集缓存

Q2: 如何设计支持千万级POI数据的实时搜索系统？

A2: 分层架构设计：
1. 数据存储层：
   - PostgreSQL+PostGIS存储完整POI数据
   - Elasticsearch建立空间索引和全文索引
   - Redis缓存热点区域数据

2. 搜索引擎层：
   - ES geo_shape查询实现空间搜索
   - 多字段组合查询(位置+关键词+分类)
   - 自定义评分算法(距离+相关性+热度)

3. 服务层优化：
   - 异步查询处理，避免阻塞
   - 查询结果分页和流式返回
   - 智能查询建议和纠错

4. 性能优化：
   - CDN加速静态地图资源
   - 负载均衡分散查询压力
   - 预计算热点区域聚合数据

Q3: GIS系统如何实现高可用和容灾备份？

A3: 全方位高可用方案：
1. 数据库高可用：
   - PostgreSQL主从复制+自动故障转移
   - 读写分离，读请求分散到从库
   - 定期全量备份+WAL日志备份

2. 服务层高可用：
   - 微服务多实例部署
   - Kubernetes自动重启和扩缩容
   - 服务网格实现熔断和降级

3. 地理分布式部署：
   - 多数据中心部署
   - 就近访问路由策略
   - 跨区域数据同步

4. 监控告警：
   - 实时监控系统性能指标
   - 数据质量监控和异常检测
   - 自动化运维和故障恢复

Q4: 如何保障GIS系统中地理数据的安全性？

A4: 多层安全防护：
1. 数据加密：
   - 数据库透明加密(TDE)
   - 敏感字段级加密
   - 传输层SSL/TLS加密

2. 访问控制：
   - 基于角色的权限管理(RBAC)
   - 地理围栏访问控制
   - API接口鉴权和限流

3. 数据脱敏：
   - 坐标偏移和精度降级
   - 敏感位置信息模糊化
   - 测试环境数据脱敏

4. 合规性：
   - GDPR地理数据保护合规
   - 数据跨境传输合规
   - 审计日志和操作追踪

Q5: 如何设计GIS微服务架构？

A5: 领域驱动设计：
1. 服务拆分策略：
   - 地图服务：瓦片生成、样式管理
   - 空间分析服务：缓冲区、叠加分析
   - 数据管理服务：CRUD、格式转换
   - 用户服务：认证、权限、偏好设置

2. 数据一致性：
   - 事件驱动架构保证最终一致性
   - Saga模式处理分布式事务
   - 数据版本控制和冲突解决

3. 服务通信：
   - REST API同步调用
   - 消息队列异步通信
   - gRPC高性能内部调用

4. 容错机制：
   - 断路器模式防止级联故障
   - 超时和重试策略
   - 服务降级和兜底方案

// 线程池配置优化
private ExecutorService createThreadPool() {
    int threadCount = Math.min(MAX_THREADS, 
        Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() * 2);
    return Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threadCount,
        new ThreadFactoryBuilder()
            .setNameFormat("stock-monitor-pool-%d")
            .setDaemon(true)
            .build());
}

// 超时控制机制
private static final long TASK_TIMEOUT_MINUTES = 5;
private static final int MAX_RETRY_TIMES = 3;

// 带重试机制的数据采集
public List<MainMonitor> getMainMonitorWithRetry(String stockID, String money) {
    int retryCount = 0;
    while (retryCount < MAX_RETRY_TIMES) {
        try {
            return getMainMonitor(stockID, money);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            retryCount++;
            log.warn("第{}次重试获取股票{}数据", retryCount, stockID);
            if (retryCount == MAX_RETRY_TIMES) {
                log.error("获取股票{}数据失败", stockID, e);
                return Collections.emptyList();
            }
        }
    }
    return Collections.emptyList();
}
Redis缓存设计 ▶ 
// 分层缓存策略
public class CacheManager {
    // 一级缓存：本地缓存（Guava Cache）
    private LoadingCache<String, Object> localCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder()
        .maximumSize(1000)
        .expireAfterWrite(5, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
        .build(new CacheLoader<String, Object>() {
            @Override
            public Object load(String key) {
                return redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(key);
            }
        });
    
    // 二级缓存：Redis集群
    @Resource
    private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    
    // 数据存储优化：压缩存储
    public void putCompressedData(String key, Object value) {
        try {
            byte[] compressed = GZIPCompressor.compress(
                SerializationUtils.serialize(value));
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(key, compressed, 1, TimeUnit.DAYS);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log.error("数据压缩失败", e);
        }
    }
}
智能选股算法引擎 ▶ 
// 多维度选股策略
public List<String> advancedStockSelection(SelectionCriteria criteria) {
    return redisTemplate.keys("StockRanking:*").parallelStream()
        .map(key -> key.split(":")[1])
        .filter(code -> filterByMarket(criteria.getMarket(), code))
        .filter(code -> filterByPrice(criteria.getPriceRange(), code))
        .filter(code -> filterByVolume(criteria.getVolume(), code))
        .filter(code -> filterByMainMonitor(criteria, code))
        .filter(code -> filterByTechnical(criteria.getTechnical(), code))
        .limit(criteria.getLimit())
        .collect(Collectors.toList());
}

// 大单分析核心算法
private boolean filterByMainMonitor(SelectionCriteria criteria, String code) {
    List<MainMonitor> todayData = getMainMonitorData(code, criteria.getDate());
    List<MainMonitor> yesterdayData = getMainMonitorData(code, getPrevDate(criteria.getDate()));
    
    if (todayData == null || yesterdayData == null) return false;
    
    // 连续大单买入判断
    boolean consecutiveValid = checkConsecutiveBuy(todayData, 
        criteria.getConsecutiveCount(), criteria.getMoneyThreshold());
    
    // 买入卖出比例
    double buySellRatio = calculateBuySellRatio(todayData, criteria.getMoneyThreshold());
    
    // 净流入金额
    long netInflow = calculateNetInflow(todayData, criteria.getMoneyThreshold());
    
    // 与昨日对比
    boolean yesterdayCondition = checkYesterdayCondition(yesterdayData, 
        criteria.getYesterdayCount(), criteria.getMoneyThreshold());
    
    return consecutiveValid && 
           buySellRatio >= criteria.getBuySellRatio() &&
           netInflow >= criteria.getMinNetInflow() &&
           yesterdayCondition;
}
